jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Role summary

Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day.

We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted.

Responsibilities

  • Product vision, grounded in real user needs

You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind.

  • Market scoping and opportunity-spotting

Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog.

  • Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you.

  • The full lifecycle

From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear.

  • The connective tissue across the company 

When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together.

The team you’ll join

You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today.

Life at Bluerock

We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock.


  • 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field  required.

  • A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations, on time and within budget.

  • Genuine ease operating cross-functionally. You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission.

  • An appetite for ambiguity and change: a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem.

  • Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification.

  • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively.

  • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment

Our hiring process

  • Hit the Apply button.

  • Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview

  • A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation.

  • An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS.


Bluerock TMS is an equal opportunities employer. We take pride in our diverse workforce and inclusive workplace. Within a small team of open-minded talents, we ensure an attractive learning environment that you are looking for!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
  • Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
  • Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
  • Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
  • AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
  • Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
  • Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
  • Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
  • Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
  • Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

Nice to Have
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
  • Early-stage startup background.
  • Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
  • Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

Senior Product Manager Software
jobs.description:
About Optics11

Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

The Role

As Senior Product Manager Software you will build a deep understanding of the software we supply to our defense partners and clients.

You will have full product ownership including strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle and contribute to adjacent hardware product strategy and propositions to, jointly with our hardware product managers, build end-to-end solutions for our defense partners and clients. You build and structure our product discovery and delivery ways of working for the software domain.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our hardware Product Managers, Data science, Software, R&D, Engineering Sales, Projects and Application Engineering teams.

No two weeks will look the same. You might speak with a defense partner about an operational challenge, turn feedback from a deployed product into a roadmap decision, test the feasibility of a new capability with System Engineering, or work with the Product Owner to translate priorities into executable increments. You will also collaborate with hardware Product Managers, Engineering, Sales and Customer Projects to ensure our software and hardware come together as one coherent solution.

You will own the software product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle, from discovery and business case through prioritization, delivery and performance.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have established a clear, evidence-based software strategy, strengthened our discovery and delivery practices, and aligned teams around the capabilities that matter most. Your work will reduce uncertainty, improve investment decisions and help Optics11 deliver scalable, commercially strong software products that solve real problems for customers operating in demanding, high-stakes environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the software product strategy by defining and articulating the direction for assigned software products or value streams, identifying customer problems and market opportunities, and balance near-term opportunities with long-term company goals.

• Provide product design authority by ensuring software concepts, capabilities and development choices remain aligned with the Underwater Security product vision and strategy throughout the product lifecycle.

• Lead customer and market discovery by developing a deep understanding of customer needs, operational use cases and buying contexts, validating direction with customers and partners, and synthesizing feedback from deployed products.

• Own software roadmap development and prioritization by defining the capabilities required to address validated needs, balancing improvements, new functionality and technology evolution, and communicating priorities across relevant teams.

• Develop business cases and commercial input by defining success measures and commercial objectives, providing evidence for portfolio investment decisions, and supporting Product Marketing with product knowledge for pricing and launch readiness.

• Coordinate the product core team by working with System Engineering on requirements and feasibility, Product Ownership on executable increments, and Project Management on customer delivery, while aligning Sales, Business Development, Customer Projects and Engineering around progress, quality and outcomes.


• Master’s degree in engineering or design, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience in Software Product Management, with a proven track record of developing, deploying and maintaining software (platform) driven solutions in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Strong understanding of software products, particularly in complex and regulated environments, e.g., industrial environments.

• In-depth knowledge of software product management and – strategy methodologies.

• Demonstratable experience in defining software product strategy and creating complete business cases.

• Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level

• Demonstrated critical thinking, adaptability to challenges, and a problem-solving mindset to creatively address user pain points.

• Proficiency in software industry standard tooling for software development and road mapping such as Jira / Jira Product Discovery / Jira Service Management, Confluence, BigPicture

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of conveying product level knowledge, decisions and roadmaps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Willingness to travel

• Drivers’ license B (or international equivalent)

Nice to Have

• Experience in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Proficiency in JAMA Connect, Siemens Polarion, SAFe, Miro, Figma, Dovetail, Amplitude, PowerBI

• Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus

Security screening

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please check:

https://english.aivd.nl/topics/s/security-screening

jobs.title: Product Owner (Microsoft, Koddex, outils collaboratifs)
jobs.description:
Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Votre rôle

Au sein de la DSI d'Exotec, vous serez responsable d'un portefeuille d'outils collaboratifs utilisés par nos Exopeople répartis en Europe, aux États-Unis et au Japon.

Votre mission consistera à définir la vision, piloter l'évolution et maximiser l'adoption des solutions collaboratives qui soutiennent les activités de l'entreprise. Vous interviendrez notamment sur l'écosystème Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Copilot, etc.) ainsi que sur Koddex, plateforme stratégique pour le partage des connaissances et la gestion de nos processus internes.

Véritable interface entre les métiers, les équipes IT et les partenaires externes, vous accompagnerez la transformation digitale d'Exotec en proposant des solutions à forte valeur ajoutée pour les utilisateurs.

Vos missions

Définir et piloter la stratégie produit

  • Porter la vision des outils collaboratifs et définir une roadmap cohérente avec les priorités métiers, la stratégie IT et les ambitions de transformation digitale d’Exotec.
  • Être responsable de la valeur produite par le portefeuille, en reliant chaque évolution à un résultat attendu pour les utilisateurs et l’entreprise.
  • Arbitrer les priorités du portefeuille en tenant compte de l’impact utilisateur, de l’adoption attendue, des contraintes techniques, des risques et de la soutenabilité des solutions.

Recueillir, challenger et prioriser les besoins

  • Être responsable de la discovery produit en recueillant des besoins de terrain auprès des utilisateurs, des métiers, de la DSI et des relais locaux en Europe, aux États-Unis et au Japon.
  • Challenger les demandes et distinguer les besoins structurants des préférences locales, en s’appuyant sur les données d’usage, les retours utilisateurs et l’impact business.
  • Garantir que les décisions de priorisation et de roadmap reposent sur des éléments objectifs, des résultats mesurables et une compréhension réelle des usages.

Piloter les évolutions et les déploiements

  • Piloter le cycle complet des évolutions, de leur cadrage jusqu’à leur mise à disposition, en garantissant la qualité, la sécurité, l’intégration et la valeur délivrée.
  • Définir les critères de réussite et les standards de qualité des solutions, afin de sécuriser leur déploiement dans l’écosystème Exotec.
  • Prendre les décisions de release et de cycle de vie en équilibrant valeur utilisateur, risques opérationnels, dépendances éditeurs et pérennité des plateformes.

Développer l’adoption et animer la gouvernance

  • Définir et porter la stratégie d’adoption des outils collaboratifs afin d’ancrer durablement de nouveaux usages, au-delà de la seule communication ou de la formation.
  • Être responsable de l’adoption effective, de la satisfaction des utilisateurs et de la réduction des irritants qui limitent l’usage de Microsoft 365 et de Koddex.
  • Aligner les métiers, la DSI, les utilisateurs clés, les éditeurs et les partenaires externes sur les priorités, les règles de gouvernance, les arbitrages et les résultats attendus.
  • Piloter la relation avec les éditeurs et partenaires stratégiques, en maîtrisant leurs engagements, leur feuille de route, leurs risques et leurs contraintes commerciales dans l’intérêt d’Exotec.
  • Garantir la cohérence, la rationalisation et l’évolution maîtrisée du portefeuille d’outils collaboratifs et de l’écosystème de connaissances.

Votre profil

  • Expérience en Product Ownership, gestion de produit ou transformation digitale.
  • Bonne connaissance des outils collaboratifs, idéalement Microsoft 365.
  • Appétence pour les environnements SaaS et la conduite du changement.
  • Capacité à faire le lien entre enjeux métiers et solutions techniques.
  • Maîtrise des méthodes Agile.
  • Anglais professionnel.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

 

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi. Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences. En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire.

jobs.title: Product Owner (m/w/d) | Festanstellung oder Freelance | München / Remote
jobs.description:
Standort: München, remote innerhalb Deutschlands

Art: Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit, jeweils mit Perspektive auf eine langfristige Partnerschaft

Warum diese Rolle

Wir bauen Software, mit der echte Unternehmen arbeiten. Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, erfahrenen und schnellen Teams, in dem du als Product Owner die Produktvision und die Umsetzung von Anfang bis Ende verantwortest, statt ein Backlog abzuarbeiten, das jemand anderes vorgekaut hat. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Engineers zusammen, steuerst KI-gestützte Entwicklungsabläufe und bringst Features innerhalb weniger Wochen vom Konzept in die Produktion.

Diese Rolle ist für jemanden, der in Systemen, Nutzen für die Anwender und operativer Klarheit denkt, nicht nur in Jira-Status.

Ehrlich gesagt: KI im Jahr 2026

Wir entwickeln schnell mit modernen KI-Werkzeugen (Cursor, Claude, Copilot usw.). Als unser Product Owner musst du selbst keinen Produktivcode schreiben, aber du musst verstehen, wie KI-native Entwicklung Lieferzyklen, Aufwandsschätzung und Scoping verändert.

Die KI-Werkzeuge können Code schreiben, aber sie wissen nicht, was unsere Kunden wirklich brauchen, wie Abläufe über Unternehmen hinweg zusammenhängen oder welche Kompromisse für unsere Architektur sinnvoll sind. Genau für dieses Urteilsvermögen suchen wir dich. Die Messlatte ist nicht „Kannst du eine User-Story-Vorlage ausfüllen?“. Die Messlatte ist: Kannst du eine unübersichtliche betriebliche Realität in glasklare Produktanforderungen übersetzen, konsequent priorisieren und Entwickler wie KI-Assistenten effizient dahin lenken, das Richtige zu bauen?

Aufgaben

Was du machst

  • Du verantwortest Roadmap und Backlog: Du definierst, schneidest und priorisierst Features vom Konzept bis zur Produktion.

  • Du übersetzt übergeordnete Geschäftsziele in präzise, umsetzbare Anforderungen und Datenmodelle, mit denen unser Engineering-Team und unsere KI-Werkzeuge arbeiten können.

  • Du sorgst für reibungslose Kommunikation zwischen Stakeholdern, Entwicklern und Anwendern, auf Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Du steuerst Sprints, räumst Hindernisse aus dem Weg und hältst das Tempo hoch, ohne unnötige Bürokratie.

  • Du prüfst ausgelieferte Features gegen die Akzeptanzkriterien und achtest auf hohe Qualität, gute UX und echten geschäftlichen Nutzen.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Produktprozesse mit unserem Wachstum weiter, hältst Feedbackschleifen kurz und die Developer Experience reibungslos.

Unser Stack und unsere Arbeitsweise

  • Methodik: agil, Lean Product Development, kurze Iterationen, wenig Bürokratie

  • Technologie: TypeScript, Python, React, Next.js, Supabase, Postgres, Cloudflare

  • KI-native Werkzeuge: Cursor, Copilot und Claude Code als fester Bestandteil unserer Entwicklung

  • Kommunikation: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

Du musst nicht programmieren, aber du sprichst fließend „Tech“ und verstehst, wie moderne Software unter der Haube gebaut wird.

Anforderungen

Was wir suchen

Must-haves

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung als Product Owner, Technical Project Manager oder Product Lead in der Softwareentwicklung.

  • Fließendes Deutsch (mindestens C1) in Wort und Schrift sowie sehr gutes Englisch (mindestens C1), unverzichtbar für die Abstimmung mit Kunden, Stakeholdern und dem Team.

  • Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis: Du kennst moderne Web-Stacks, Datenbanken (Postgres) und APIs und weißt, wie Softwarearchitektur funktioniert.

  • Vertrautheit mit KI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung und ihren Auswirkungen auf Produktplanung und Tempo.

  • Leidenschaft für Klarheit: Du schreibst knappe Spezifikationen, Edge Cases und Akzeptanzkriterien, die keine Fragen offenlassen.

  • Selbstständige, pragmatische und proaktive Arbeitsweise.

Nice-to-haves

  • Hintergrund in Softwareentwicklung oder Informatik.

  • Erfahrung in Start-ups oder in schnellen, erfahrenen Produktteams.

  • Praxis mit modernen Kollaborations- und Projektwerkzeugen (Linear, Notion, GitHub Projects).

Uns sind dein Urteilsvermögen beim Strukturieren und dein Umsetzungstempo deutlich wichtiger als die Länge deines Lebenslaufs.

Benefits

So arbeiten wir

  • Kleines, erfahrenes Team: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Gründern und Engineers. Deine Entscheidungen zählen vom ersten Tag an.

  • Flexibel: remote innerhalb Deutschlands, Standort München. Wichtig ist uns verlässliche Erreichbarkeit zu den üblichen Geschäftszeiten.

  • Wenig Bürokratie: klare Verantwortlichkeiten, schnelles Feedback, keine endlosen Abstimmungsrunden.

Was wir bieten

  • Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit, je nachdem, was besser zu dir passt.

  • Eine Vergütung, die deiner Erfahrung entspricht, als Gehalt oder als Tages- bzw. Stundensatz.

  • Die langfristige Perspektive, unseren Produktkern zu verantworten.

  • Viel Eigenverantwortung und unmittelbare Wirkung auf ein echtes Produkt, das von aktiven Unternehmen genutzt wird.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns eine kurze Nachricht über dich, deinen Hintergrund und deine Verfügbarkeit, dazu deine Gehaltsvorstellung oder deinen Tagessatz sowie dein LinkedIn-Profil oder Portfolio. Erzähl uns von einem komplexen Produkt oder Projekt, das du erfolgreich vom Chaos zur Klarheit geführt hast.

Kein Aufsatz nötig. Wir sehen uns jede Bewerbung an und antworten allen.

About us

Smallpdf was founded in 2013 with one simple belief: working with documents shouldn’t be complicated. Today, we’re an industry leader in digital document solutions, trusted by millions of users across 195+ countries. We build intuitive, powerful tools that help individuals and businesses work smarter with their documents. From compressing and converting files to editing and e-signing, our platform makes complex document workflows simple, secure, and accessible.

As a product-led company headquartered in Switzerland and powered by a diverse, global team from 35+ countries, we combine product excellence with a strong focus on user experience, data-driven decision-making and continuous innovation. We operate at the intersection of simplicity and performance, building scalable solutions that power everyday productivity for individuals and businesses alike. Our team is driven by ownership, experimentation and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful impact at scale.

About the role

Over 60 million people use Smallpdf every month to do one thing: compress a file, convert it, translate it, merge it. Our core tools are freemium and SEO-led: people find us through Google and, more and more, through AI assistants. They finish the job and leave.

As Product Manager for our core tools, you make that single task the fastest, easiest and best on the market, so search engines, AI assistants and people send users back. You own the individual tools end to end. Together with our growth team, you work on the channels that bring people to them: organic search, paid search and AI search. You work in Zurich with a fully staffed product team, including an EM, a designer and engineering counterparts, and closely with our SEO, growth and marketing teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the individual tools end to end: upload experience, processing, output quality, download

  • Work with our SEO, SEM and growth teams on how people reach the tools, including positioning with marketing so people remember us by name

  • Help turn AI search and LLMs into a real acquisition channel, from first users to a tracked source of traffic

  • Ship AI features where they help users, with a clear process for accuracy, cost and quality before launch

  • Design, monitor and analyse experiments on millions of sessions, and ship, iterate or kill on the result

  • Run deep analyses and user research yourself, and be the voice of the user in every decision

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for your area from user feedback, data and business goals, with a commercial case, cost and outcome metrics for every bet

  • Align engineering, design, SEO, growth, marketing and other product teams on what ships and why

  • Lead without authority: manage up with clear recommendations, settle ownership with peer teams, and present plans and results to leadership and the whole company

  • Raise the bar around you: help your team own product decisions, give and take honest feedback, coach others, and step outside the PM role when it moves the needle

About you

  • 6+ years in product management

  • Hands-on A/B testing experience on a product with real traffic

  • AI in your daily work: workflows, analysis, prototyping, research. You know where it goes wrong and you check it

  • Experience defining need & quality for an AI feature, or a clear view of how you would do it

  • Comfortable talking with engineers about trade-offs, speed, errors and estimations

  • Dynamic and hands-on: you make quick decisions based on real data

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you find the problem worth solving when nobody has named it yet

  • Curious and rigorous: you dig into the data yourself until the answer holds

  • You run user research yourself, and bring what you learn into decisions

  • Commercially minded: you know what a feature is worth before you build it

  • A clear communicator who aligns people without needing authority, with excellent written and spoken English

Nice to have

  • Document or file-processing products

  • A utility business with a strong free tier

  • Experience with high-volume consumer tools

  • Experience with SEO, SEM or AI search as acquisition channels

Important note: this is a hybrid role based in our Zurich office. You either already live in the Zurich area or are willing to relocate.

Join Smallpdf - Where innovation meets impact!

Becoming part of our team means more than just taking a job - it’s joining a dynamic, collaborative environment where your voice matters, your growth is championed, and your work truly makes a difference.

Here, we don’t just talk about a growth mindset - we live it. You’ll thrive in a culture that balances professional ambition with personal well-being, where flexibility, creativity, and purpose come together. Whether you're shaping the future through groundbreaking projects or leveling up your skills, your journey here will be one of impact, innovation, and continuous learning. This reflects in our company values.

Our Benefits

🌍 You get to impact the way over 60 million people get work done every month.

How to Apply

Smallpdf is an equal-opportunity employer, and we believe our strength comes from a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, identities, perspectives, and lived experiences. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
What we do

At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.

Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.

Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.

After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.

If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.


What you'll be doing

You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.

You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.

We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.

Own the wealth product area end to end

  • Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
  • Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
  • Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
  • Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it

Turn the data into something users act on

  • Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
  • Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
  • Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway

Own the numbers

  • Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
  • Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
  • Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you


What we are looking for

You might be a fit if:

  • You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
  • You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
  • You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
  • You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
  • Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
  • You're fluent in English; German is a plus
  • You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany

That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 

Strong plus if you have:

  • PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
  • Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
  • Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
  • Subscription and paywall experimentation
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other product managers
  • Your own portfolio, and opinions about it

If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.

Work authorisation

This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.

What the first six months look like

  • Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
  • Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
  • Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
  • Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you

You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.


Why join getquin?

Why join getquin?

We're a fast-growing B2C fintech, and here, your work has real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of your domain, ship features end-to-end, and help shape the direction of a product used across Europe. We value initiative, ownership and creativity, not layers of process.

Three things that are specifically true of this role:

  • Wealth management is ripe for disruption. Following digitalisation waves of banking and brokerage services, we are leading those efforts across the next big topic for private individuals: better understand  and optimize your wealth
  • The data asset is genuinely rare. Aggregated cross-institution wealth for half a million people, with over +€25bn in connected assets. Trade Republic sees its own platform. N26 sees the current account. Nobody else in Europe sees the whole picture, which means there are product questions you can only answer here
  • You'll own the area, not a slice of it. At our size the decisions are yours

Ready to build something meaningful? Then join us at the forefront of making wealth building accessible to everyone.

How we hire

Five conversations, typically three to four weeks from first call to decision. We tell you where you stand after every step, and we respond within seven days at every stage.

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 min, video. Role, scope, the salary band, hybrid expectation, notice period, work authorisation. No trick questions
  2. Hiring manager, 60 min, video. Your product area ownership, the outcome you drove, and your depth in the wealth domain. This is the first real fit conversation, in both directions
  3. Product case, take home. We give you a real getquin problem on aggregated wealth data and work through it together. We know you already have a job, hence we do not impose an in-person case during working hours
  4. Cross-functional panel, 2 x 30 min, in our Berlin office. Cover in more depth your case study and deep dive further in your understanding of product metrics and approach to product development. Usually in person in our office.
  5. Close conversation, 30 min. Team fit, how you like to work, and whatever is still open, including your questions for a founder

Along the last part we will be making reference checks, but only with former employers. Once we have this, we will make you a formal offer. 

The whole loop runs in English. Tell us if you need any adjustment to the process, whether timing, format or accessibility, and we'll make it. You don't need to explain why.

Bouw mee aan het cloudplatform waarop heel Univé draait.

Wie ben jij

Jij bent een ervaren Product Owner die strategisch denken combineert met technische diepgang.

Wat ga je doen

Als Product Owner van het CCC ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen business, productteams, architectuur, security en de MSP. Jij vertaalt de visie naar waardevolle platformdiensten, bepaalt prioriteiten op basis van risico, waarde en technische haalbaarheid, en zorgt dat het cloudplatform continu doorontwikkeld wordt. Je combineert strategische keuzes met voldoende technische diepgang om te begrijpen wát er nodig is voor een state‑of‑the‑art cloudomgeving — en waarom.
 

Jouw rol
 

Als Product Owner binnen het CCC:

  • geef je richting aan de doorontwikkeling van het Univé‑cloudplatform op basis van de CCC‑visie en het Cloud Capability Model;

  • werk je nauw samen met architectuur, security en de MSP om standaarden, kaders en guardrails te definiëren en te bewaken;

  • zorg je voor een scherpe, realistische en waarde‑gedreven roadmap voor platformdiensten, automatisering, beveiliging en landing zones;

  • maak je keuzes die bijdragen aan standaardisatie, toekomstbestendigheid en veilige autonomie van productteams;

  • prioriteer je de backlog in balans tussen innovatie, betrouwbaarheid, vervolgtechniek en compliance;

  • fungeer je als sparringpartner voor engineers, architecten en de MSP;

  • borg je dat nieuwe cloudcapaciteiten voldoen aan ontwerpprincipes, governance‑richtlijnen en security‑eisen;

  • stimuleer je kennisdeling en samenwerking binnen Univé. 

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden


Strategie & Roadmap

  • vertalen van de CCC‑visie naar een concrete productstrategie;

  • opstellen en bewaken van de roadmap voor platformdiensten, automatisering, landing zones en PaaS‑diensten;

Samenwerking & Regie

  • voeren van regie op de MSP en bewaken van kwaliteit, volwassenheid en doorontwikkeling;

  • afstemmen met architectuur, security, servicemanagement en productteams;

Techniek & Inhoud

  • begrijpen van centrale cloudcomponenten zoals landing zones, netwerken, security‑baselines, automatisering en containerplatformen;

  • doorvertalen van technische kaders naar backlogitems;

Governance & Kwaliteit

  • waarborgen van compliance, standaardisatie en veilige cloudadoptie binnen Univé;

  • monitoren van platformprestaties en servicekwaliteit. 

Wat bieden wij

  • een sleutelrol binnen het Cloud Competence Center;

  • ruimte om te pionieren en professionaliseren;

  • afwisseling tussen architectuur en hands‑on engineering;

  • collega’s die voor kwaliteit en eenvoud gaan;

  • een moderne omgeving waar cloud, automatisering en security topprioriteit zijn

Bij Univé IT bieden we je een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische organisatie. De salarisrange ligt tussen € 64.830,24 en € 93.155,08 bruto per jaar op basis van een 38-urige werk-week (inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning).

De belangrijkste arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rijtje:

 

  • je krijgt een prima salaris, afhankelijk van je opleiding, ervaring en competenties;

  • 13e maand;

  • 8% vakantiegeld variabele Collectieve Prestatie Beloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;

  • arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd;

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;

  • goede studiekostenregeling;

  • prima pensioenvoorziening;

  • reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding;

  • en natuurlijk: korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Het team heeft een fijne werkplek in Zwolle, vlakbij het station. In overleg met het team behoort 2-3 dagen thuiswerken tot de mogelijkheden. 

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dicht bij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie. 

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé.  

Drie focusgebieden 
 

De IT-organisatie is  ingericht met drie primaire afdelingen op de focusgebieden Kern, Data en Distributie. De CIO Office biedt ondersteuning door richting en houvast te geven aan strategische doelen en kaders. De afdeling IT Kern levert een state of the art IT-fundament voor de Univé-organisatie om de businessdoelen te realiseren: betrouwbaar en efficiënt en met een perfecte performance. De afdeling IT Kern bestaat uit vier teams:
 

  • Services – werkplekdiensten, 1e lijns gebruikersondersteuning, Proces- & Servicemanagement en consultancy

  • Frontend Platform – applicatiemanagement van platformen die vooral het contact met onze leden ondersteunen zoals onze online omgeving, CRM en telefonie

  • Backend Platform – applicatiemanagement van platformen die vooral ‘de achterkant processen’ ondersteunen zoals de polis-, claim- en financiële administratie

  • Infra & Security Platform – Cloud Competence Center en operationele security activiteiten

Binnen Infra en Security Platform zijn we op zoek naar een Cloud Specialist voor het Cloud Competence Center die ons verder helpt de professionalisering van ons cloudlandschap te realiseren.
 

Het Cloud Competence Center (CCC) binnen Univé is dé centrale plek waar cloudexpertise, innovatiekracht en toekomstbestendige standaarden samenkomen. Vanuit dit regie‑ en kenniscentrum ondersteunen wij de hele organisatie bij veilig, efficiënt en schaalbaar cloudgebruik. Om onze ambities verder vorm te geven, zoeken wij een veelzijdige Cloud Specialist — een professional die zich thuis voelt in een multidisciplinaire rol en energie krijgt van zowel strategisch ontwerpen als hands‑on realiseren.

Om deze beweging verder vorm te geven zoeken we een Product Owner die zowel strategisch richting geeft als diep genoeg in de materie kan duiken om het cloudplatform inhoudelijk te sturen.

jobs.title: Product Manager - CDI
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

 

Notre mission

 

Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation.

⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation. Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement”

👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !

💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux !

 

Le mot de la CEO

“Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs.
Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon

 

Et ce poste alors ?

 

Le rôle

Nous recherchons notre Founding Marketing Manager pour construire le moteur d'acquisition et de notoriété de Solteo. Premier recrutement marketing de l'entreprise, tu pars d'une page presque blanche : stratégie, canaux, budget et marque sont à construire, en lien direct avec Manon (CEO).

Ton objectif : générer un flux régulier de leads qualifiés pour l'équipe commerciale, à un coût d'acquisition maîtrisé, et faire de Solteo une référence de l'électrification des bâtiments auprès des installateurs. Tu accompagneras aussi le lancement de nos nouvelles offres.

 

Missions et responsabilités

Tu prendras la responsabilité d'un périmètre produit de bout en bout : comprendre les problèmes de nos utilisateurs, identifier les meilleures opportunités, concevoir et cadrer les solutions avec l'équipe, les amener jusqu'en production et mesurer leur impact.

Nous cherchons surtout quelqu'un de très autonome, pragmatique et à l'aise dans un environnement startup, où tout n'est pas toujours parfaitement défini et où il faut savoir avancer, arbitrer et mettre les mains dans le cambouis.

  1. Discovery continue

Tu développes une compréhension fine de nos utilisateurs, de leurs usages et de leurs irritants. Tu combines échanges terrain, retours des équipes et analyse des données pour identifier et prioriser les opportunités à plus fort impact.

  1. Shaping & conception

Tu transformes des problèmes parfois encore flous en sujets bien cadrés et en solutions simples. Tu es capable de matérialiser rapidement une idée à travers des parcours, wireframes ou prototypes, et de la challenger avec les utilisateurs et l'équipe.

  1. Delivery & impact

Tu travailles étroitement avec les développeurs pour amener les sujets jusqu'en production, sans perdre de vue le problème initial. Une fois les fonctionnalités livrées, tu mesures leur adoption et leur impact pour comprendre ce qui fonctionne — ou non — et continuer à itérer.

  1. Ownership & autonomie

Tu n'attends pas que quelqu'un découpe précisément ton travail. Lorsque tu identifies un problème important, tu cherches à le comprendre, tu impliques les bonnes personnes et tu fais avancer le sujet.

 

Tes objectifs:

⭐ Les 30 premiers jours — Comprendre

Ton premier objectif sera d'absorber un maximum de contexte : le produit Solteo, nos utilisateurs et leurs métiers, le marché photovoltaïque, notre fonctionnement Produit & Tech et nos principaux enjeux business.

Tu participeras rapidement à des échanges avec nos clients et commenceras à travailler sur de vrais sujets produit.

🎯 Objectif : comprendre qui sont nos utilisateurs, comment ils utilisent Solteo, leurs principaux problèmes et les enjeux derrière notre roadmap.

⭐ De 1 à 3 mois — Prendre en main ton périmètre

Tu prendras progressivement la responsabilité d'un périmètre produit. Tu mèneras tes propres investigations, participeras au shaping des sujets, concevras les solutions avec l'équipe et suivras leur livraison.

🎯 Objectif : mener de manière autonome un sujet produit, de la compréhension du problème jusqu'à sa mise en production.

⭐ De 3 à 12 mois — Devenir pleinement autonome

Tu pilotes ton périmètre avec beaucoup d'autonomie : comprendre les problèmes, identifier les opportunités, définir les priorités, construire les bons sujets avec l'équipe et mesurer leur impact.

🎯 Objectif : être pleinement responsable de l'impact produit de ton périmètre et contribuer activement à faire évoluer notre manière de construire le produit.

 

Les compétences qu’on recherche

 

  • Tu as 3+ ans d'expérience en Product Management, idéalement sur un produit SaaS B2B.

  • Tu es à l'aise dans un environnement start-up : le flou ne te paralyse pas et tu sais avancer sans avoir toutes les réponses.

  • Tu as un bon sens produit et UX et sais transformer un problème complexe en une solution simple.

  • Tu es à l'aise aussi bien avec les utilisateurs qu'avec les équipes techniques.

  • Tu sais utiliser la donnée pour challenger tes intuitions et mesurer l'impact de ce que tu construis.

  • Tu es autonome, curieux·se et pragmatique : quand il faut creuser un sujet ou mettre les mains dans le cambouis, tu le fais.

 

Ce qui serait un plus

Tu n'as pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases, mais on sera particulièrement intéressés si :

  • tu as déjà évolué dans une startup ou scale-up SaaS B2B avec une forte culture d'exécution ;

  • tu sais utiliser PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude ou un outil similaire ;

  • tu sais écrire des requêtes SQL pour explorer toi-même les données ;

  • tu as utilisé des outils no-code / low-code pour prototyper, automatiser ou tester rapidement une idée ;

  • tu te débrouilles sur Figma et Claude Code (ou Codex), sans être Product designer ou développeur.

  • tu as une expérience avec des logiciels métiers complexes ;

  • tu as déjà travaillé avec des artisans, des indépendants ou des professionnels du BTP ;

  • tu connais ou as déjà utilisé Shape Up — sinon, pas de panique, ça s'apprend vite ;

  • tu t'intéresses au secteur de l'énergie et à la transition énergétique ;

  • tu connais la différence entre un kWc et un kWh.

Mais Solteo c’est aussi…

  • Un cadre professionnel vivant et énergique, où la prise d’initiatives est non seulement appréciée mais également récompensée.

  • La chance de parfaire et d'enrichir tes connaissances dans un secteur en pleine croissance et qui a du sens.

  • Des bureaux situés en plein centre de Paris, avec plusieurs autres start-ups du solaire

  • Une diversité de projets captivants, offrant l'opportunité de collaborer avec des clients diverses et variés. Pas possible de s’ennuyer !

Nous te promettons aussi une ambiance d’équipe bienveillante, accueillante et stimulante. Et bien sûr, plein d’évènements d’équipe !

 

Processus de recrutement

  • 📞 Entretien de cadrage au téléphone (20 min) : pour discuter de ton CV et des attentes sur le poste.

  • 🤝 Entretien de fit en visio (45 min) : pour faire connaissance, discuter de ton parcours et de tes motivations avec un Co-fondateur et le COO (Mehdi).

  • 🎯 Entretien technique avec l’équipe commerciale (1h00) : mise en situation pratique sur un business case avec le Head of Product et le COO ou PM.

  • 🕵️‍♂️ Prise de références (Réf call).

  • 🍽️ Déjeuner d’équipe : rencontre conviviale avec les fondateurs et toute l'équipe Solteo.

 

Détails du poste

  • CDI - temps Plein

  • Paris 17e

  • Prise de poste: dès que possible

  • Rémunération : 45k€ – 55k€, selon expérience

jobs.title: Impact Producer
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

The ElevenLabs Impact Program exists to democratize access to our technology and make AI work for all people, supporting for-good use cases across healthcare, education, and culture. Today, some of our work includes providing free and discounted access to nonprofits, partnering with university professors to bring voice AI into the classroom and the research lab, and working to restore the voices of one million people living with permanent voice loss through our 1 Million Voices initiative (learn more at elevenlabs.io/impact). We're looking for a Producer to own the external storytelling and event presence for Impact, a role that coordinates PR, agency management, social launches, documentary-style case studies, and event production. This is a hands-on, in-house role: you're the person who makes sure every launch, film, and activation meets (or, ideally raises) the bar of the rest of the company's output, working closely with our internal Design, Comms, and Events teams, and, when applicable, with the external agencies and production teams supporting PR, film, and creative execution. As Impact's first dedicated producer, you'll build the production and launch engine for a team whose external footprint is scaling fast, this quarter alone includes 5+ events, six documentaries in production, two live ElevenLabs Summit sessions, a partner launch every month, and several more case studies in flight.

What you'll do

  • Coordinate production of Impact's documentary case studies: travel and work onsite for filming when needed, work closely with external production and direction teams, bringing opinions on story and craft, and partner with our Design team to make sure every film meets ElevenLabs' bar and brand guidelines.

  • Plan and execute Impact's conferences and activations alongside the Events team, turning each one into an in-person moment that drives real ROI and leaves a lasting impression, with Impact's own storytelling angle built in.

  • Support Comms in telling Impact's story through PR, coordinating with Comms and, when applicable, a PR agency to keep press windows and partner announcements on track, and helping make sure Impact's international stories get told well as the program expands globally.

  • Partner with Design to keep all video and static collateral on-brand, advocating for a high creative standard and Impact’s lens.

  • Carry a consistent visual and narrative thread across launches, blog content, and ElevenLabs Summit presentations.

  • Draft copy for social and blog content, collaborating with Comms to land a final draft, and with Design on all launch-related visual assets.

  • Manage multiple concurrent launches, shoots, and events at once.

Requirements

  • A great project manager with a sharp creative eye, someone who runs cross-functional logistics flawlessly, has real taste, and will push the team to hit it.

  • Organized and detail-oriented, with a track record of juggling several production timelines at once.

  • Creative or production background (agency, marketing, in-house brand/content team, documentary or branded content) comfortable being on set and in the room with Design, not just commissioning the work.

  • Strong writing and visual taste; can tell when something is on-brand and polish-worthy.

  • 2-5 years of experience in production, events, or brand marketing.

  • Comfortable traveling for shoots and events.

Senior Director, Commercial Sales
jobs.description:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

Zip is looking for a Senior Director of EMEA Commercial Sales to lead and scale our Commercial business across Europe.

This is a second-line leadership role. You will initially lead two frontline Commercial Sales Managers and, through them, a growing team of Account Executives. As Zip expands across Europe, you will build the leadership structure, sales capacity, and go-to-market approach required to capture that opportunity.

Your leverage comes through your managers, but this is not a role for someone who operates from a distance. You will stay close to the business: understanding the pipeline, inspecting deals, helping your managers improve their teams, and personally getting involved in the opportunities where your experience can change the outcome.

You will own the performance of EMEA Commercial end to end: the number, pipeline, forecast, talent, geographic expansion, and operating rhythm of the segment.

Commercial is already an important part of Zip's EMEA business. The opportunity now is to turn it into a scaled, predictable growth engine across the region.

You Will

  • Own EMEA Commercial performance. Deliver quarterly and annual new-business revenue targets through the frontline managers and Account Executives who report into your organization.

  • Build and develop exceptional frontline managers. Coach your leaders on pipeline management, forecasting, deal inspection, rep development, and performance management. Hold them accountable for running their businesses with the same rigor you bring to yours.

  • Scale Commercial across Europe. Determine where and when to add coverage as Zip expands into new countries and markets, and build the teams and leadership required to win locally without creating unnecessary complexity.

  • Own pipeline well before the quarter begins. Establish coverage requirements, identify future gaps early, and work across Business Development, Marketing, Partnerships, and the AE organization to address them before they become revenue problems.

  • Drive rigorous forecasting. Build a business that is predictable. Know what is real, what is at risk, what has changed, and why, and ensure your managers operate with the same level of precision.

  • Stay close to the deals. Ensure your managers are inspecting opportunities rigorously, and personally engage in important customer conversations where executive involvement can improve discovery, create urgency, strengthen sponsorship, or move a deal forward.

  • Build a high-performance organization. Recruit outstanding managers and sellers, raise the talent bar as we grow, develop top performers, and address underperformance quickly and directly.

  • Improve the Commercial sales motion. Diagnose where performance is constrained by pipeline, execution, territory design, productivity, process, or capability and make the changes required to improve it.

  • Operate cross-functionally. Build strong partnerships with Business Development, Solution Consulting, Advisory, Marketing, Partnerships, GTM Operations, Customer, and Zip's Executive team.

  • Represent the Commercial business internally. Provide clear, credible reporting on performance, pipeline, forecast, market dynamics, competitive trends, and the investments required to continue scaling.

  • Build for where Zip is going, not where it is today. Create the leadership bench, operating model, and market coverage that will support a significantly larger EMEA Commercial organization over the next several years.

To Excel in This Role

  • You have successfully led frontline sales managers, not only individual sellers.

  • You know that your job as an L2 is not to run every deal yourself. You make your managers better at running their teams while knowing when your involvement can materially improve an outcome.

  • You are rigorous about pipeline creation and pipeline quality. You think several quarters ahead rather than discovering a pipeline problem once the quarter has begun.

  • You run a predictable business and have a strong track record of forecast accuracy and operational discipline.

  • You are comfortable getting into the details. You can move from a regional strategy discussion to inspecting a deal, a territory, a rep's pipeline, or a manager's operating cadence without losing altitude.

  • You have built or expanded sales teams across multiple European markets and understand that what works in the UK does not automatically translate into Germany, France, Benelux, Nordics, or Southern Europe.

  • You have a track record of hiring and developing strong sales leaders and creating a bench of future leadership talent.

  • You are equally comfortable with high expectations and hands-on coaching. You give clear, actionable feedback and address problems early.

  • You operate well in a fast-growth environment where the organization, product, market, and playbook are all evolving quickly.

  • You have a strong executive presence and can build credibility with senior customer stakeholders while keeping the Account Executive and frontline manager at the center of the relationship.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of B2B technology sales experience, including meaningful sales leadership experience.

  • 2+ years managing frontline sales managers or equivalent second-line leadership responsibility.

  • Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding revenue targets through teams.

  • Demonstrated experience scaling sales organizations across territories, countries, or customer segments.

  • Strong experience with pipeline management, forecasting, sales process, territory design, productivity metrics, and performance management.

  • Experience hiring and developing both sales managers and Account Executives.

  • Experience operating in a high-growth SaaS or enterprise technology company.

  • Experience selling through value-based, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Based in the UK and able to work from Zip's central London office three days per week.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience building sales teams outside the UK and entering new European markets.

  • Experience leading a high-velocity Commercial or mid-market SaaS organization.

  • Experience selling to Procurement, Finance, IT, Legal, or other cross-functional enterprise buyers.

  • Experience at a company scaling from an early EMEA presence into a substantial pan-European business.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • 📈 Start-up equity

  • 🦷 Full health, vision & dental coverage

  • 🚍 Commuter benefit

  • 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

  • 🌴 Flexible PTO

  • 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget

  • Employer pension contribution

 

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

  • You likely have 3+ years of experience in a demanding environment such as management consulting, technology, healthcare operations, a start-up or scale-up, or project/programme management.



You bring:

  • Proven experience delivering projects in hospitals, ideally multi-site rollouts across large hospital groups

  • Experience setting up and running project governance, such as steering committees, workstreams and regular status reporting

  • Experience leading cross-functional project teams and driving results without direct authority

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication, from clinical staff on the ward to senior leadership

  • Experience in change management and driving adoption in clinical environments

  • Proven experience with the German-speaking hospital landscape, including hospital IT systems, data protection and compliance approvals, and works or staff council processes

  • A strong bias towards action and ownership

  • The ability to work independently and structure ambiguous problems

  • Professional fluency in German and English (C1 or higher)



What you will do

  • Own large, mainly hospital, deployments end-to-end, including project plans, timelines, dependencies, risks and stakeholder alignment

  • Coordinate clinicians, hospital leadership, IT, data protection and information security officers, and internal teams to keep deployments moving

  • Prepare and support teams through training and go-live, including regular on-site work across Germany, Austria and Switzerland

  • Drive adoption after go-live and work with clinical champions to identify and address barriers

  • Proactively identify and resolve issues, bringing the right people together when you need support

  • Work closely with internal specialists such as MedOps and TechOps, who own parts of the implementation that fit their expertise, while you drive the project and remain accountable for the overall outcome

  • Improve our implementation approach by developing better processes, tools and ways of working as we scale



What you will get

  • Real ownership and autonomy from day one

  • The opportunity to directly shape how AI is adopted in healthcare

  • The chance to grow your career while making a meaningful impact on the future of healthcare within a fast-growing European healthtech scale-up

  • Exposure to clinicians, hospital leadership, technology and commercial teams

  • Competitive salary and quarterly bonus

  • Regular team events and an international, high-performing team



Location
We believe the best ideas happen when we're together. This is a full-time role based in Munich, Germany.
This role involves regular travel across the DACH region and may include extended on-site periods during go-lives.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

Du setzt den fachlichen und kaufmännischen Rahmen: Du verstehst, was Kunden brauchen, priorisierst Anforderungen, definierst das gewünschte Ergebnis und prüfst anschließend selbst, ob die Umsetzung funktioniert.

Wir suchen ausdrücklich eine umsetzungsstarke Persönlichkeit: jemanden, der Themen voranbringt, Entscheidungen vorbereitet, offene Punkte klärt und Verantwortung bis zum funktionierenden Ergebnis übernimmt. Reines Ticket-Pingpong ist nicht unser Verständnis von Product Ownership.

Aufgaben

  • Kundenfeedback und Anforderungen aufnehmen, hinterfragen und priorisieren
  • eigene Produktideen und Verbesserungsvorschläge entwickeln
  • Anforderungen klar und verständlich für unser Entwicklerteam formulieren
  • fachliche Rückfragen während der Umsetzung klären
  • neue Funktionen selbst testen und aus Produktsicht freigeben
  • passende Software- und Technologiepartner recherchieren, bewerten und ansprechen
  • Integrationen mit externen Partnern begleiten
  • insbesondere neue Payment Provider identifizieren und deren Integration koordinieren

Ein neues Feature kann dabei eine Softwarefunktion, eine Änderung an unseren Geräten oder die Integration eines externen Partners sein.

Qualifikation

  • kaufmännisches Denken und ein gutes Verständnis für Kundenbedürfnisse
  • erste relevante Erfahrung in Product Management, Account Management, Customer Success, Projektmanagement oder Business Development
  • gutes technisches Verständnis – du musst nicht programmieren können, solltest dich aber sicher mit Entwicklern über Anforderungen und Funktionen austauschen können
  • eine strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise
  • klare Kommunikation mit Kunden, Partnern und Entwicklern
  • eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass Themen von allein weiterlaufen
  • Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Dinge bis zum Ergebnis zu treiben
  • fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Deutsch brauchst du für die enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden, Englisch für die tägliche Abstimmung mit unserem internationalen Entwicklerteam.

Erfahrung mit Payment oder Softwareintegrationen ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Benefits

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle mit viel Verantwortung in einem schnell wachsenden, hochinnovativen Startup
  • Ein kleines, internationales Team mit Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt
  • Eine offene Arbeitskultur mit flachen Hierarchien und schnellen Entscheidungswegen
  • Ein hundefreundliches Büro in zentraler Lage mit vielen Restaurants, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und sehr guter ÖPNV-Anbindung
  • Kostenlose EGYM Wellpass Mitgliedschaft für dein Workout

Die Rolle ist vor Ort im Büro angelegt, weil der direkte Austausch mit unserem Entwicklerteam ein zentraler Teil der Arbeit ist.

Du kannst Anforderungen persönlich besprechen, Fragen schnell klären und neue Funktionen direkt gemeinsam am Produkt testen.

Statt Anforderungen nur über Tickets weiterzureichen, arbeitest du eng mit den Menschen zusammen, die sie umsetzen.
