Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

Pelico is seeking a Lead AI Product Manager to pioneer our agent-first product strategy in Paris. You'll define and build the next generation of autonomous AI agents that transform how aerospace and manufacturing companies plan, optimize, and execute complex supply chain operations. This is a unique opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI in enterprise B2B, creating intelligent systems that make decisions, take actions, and deliver measurable business value autonomously.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product vision and execution for autonomous AI agents — define agent architectures, multi-agent systems, and agentic workflows that transform supply chain planning, inventory optimization, production scheduling, and MRO operations

  • Lead complex cross-functional AI initiatives — drive discovery of high-value use cases, design agent personas and reasoning patterns, and pioneer agent-native UX paradigms including conversational interfaces and proactive recommendations

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, customer operations, sales, and enterprise customers to ensure AI features deliver measurable value and achieve adoption at scale

  • Define the AI product vision and strategic roadmap with VP Product and engineering leadership, balancing innovation with enterprise deployment requirements around scalability, explainability, security, and compliance

  • Drive excellence in AI product development — from experimentation frameworks to deployment best practices — championing data-driven decision making and rapid iteration to launch capabilities that deliver 10x productivity improvements to enterprise customers

About You

  • 5+ years in product management with 3+ years building AI/ML products, including hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, autonomous agents, or intelligent automation in Enterprise B2B SaaS

  • Strong technical acumen across agent architectures — including multi-agent systems, LLM-based reasoning, tool use, RAG, RLHF, and safety mechanisms — to collaborate effectively with ML engineers and data scientists

  • Proven track record shipping autonomous AI products to large enterprise customers, with experience navigating safety, compliance, auditability, and controlled autonomy requirements

  • Outstanding communication skills in English and French — able to articulate complex agentic AI concepts to executives, engineers, and end users alike

  • You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work — curious about what’s possible and quick to adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows — whether for writing, research, analysis, coding, or productivity — and a genuine interest in staying at the frontier of what these tools can do.

  • Experience building agent-based products with frameworks like LangChain, AutoGPT, CrewAI, or custom agent architectures

  • Background in operations research, supply chain, manufacturing, or aerospace industries

Why Pelico

We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

  • Meaningful equity — you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

  • Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

  • Flexible, hybrid work model — we care about output, not face time

  • Alan health coverage — up to 70% covered by Pelico

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Software Delivery
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role

As Senior Product Manager, Software Delivery, you will sit at the handoff point between ideas and engineering — taking a raw idea or ask and shaping it into a well-formed request the software team can build against. You own the what: defining the problem, scope, and acceptance criteria behind every request. Working alongside the Project Manager, who runs sprints and day-to-day delivery mechanics, you'll advocate for how requests should be sequenced and when they should land, making sure priority calls reflect the needs behind the work rather than just what's next in the queue.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.

Responsibilities:

  • Turn ideas into formal requests: work with the Product Lead and other stakeholders to take a defined ask and translate it into a clear, engineering-ready ticket — problem statement, scope, acceptance criteria, and any relevant regulatory or clinical context — before it enters the backlog.

  • Own and prioritise the software ticket pipeline in Jira: intake, triage, and grooming, so the backlog reflects real, current priority rather than the order things happened to arrive in.

  • Own the idea-to-documentation handoff with the software team — making sure every piece of work that reaches engineering has the context, requirements, and supporting documentation it needs in Confluence, and that decisions made along the way are captured rather than lost in Slack.

  • Advocate for how and when work should happen: partner with the Project Manager, who owns sprint planning and delivery mechanics, to make sure sequencing and timing reflect genuine priority rather than convenience.

  • Keep the software pipeline's information in the right place — Jira for delivery, Confluence for documentation — rather than in slide decks or side channels, and help extend that operating model as the team grows.

Skills & Experience:

  • Experience as a Product Manager, Technical Product Manager, or Product Owner working directly with a software engineering team, ideally in a regulated or safety-conscious environment.

  • Comfort writing requirements and acceptance criteria precise enough for engineers to build against without repeated back-and-forth.

  • A natural translator: equally comfortable in a conversation with a non-technical stakeholder describing a problem and in a ticket-grooming session with engineers debating implementation trade-offs.

  • Comfortable in an early-stage environment where requests arrive informally and priorities shift, and where part of the job is imposing structure rather than just following it.

  • Drawn to the operational side of product management — energised by getting the machinery of idea-to-delivery running smoothly, not just by defining the vision.

  • Nice to have: experience in medical devices or another regulated hardware/software environment, with exposure to documentation practices under ISO 13485 or IEC 62304.

  • Nice to have: prior experience setting up or overhauling a ticket intake and triage process from scratch, rather than inheriting one.

  • Nice to have: some exposure to embedded or real-time software, enough to sanity-check scope and complexity when shaping requests.

Benefits:

  • Company equity plan so all employees share in the success of the company

  • Salary-sacrifice pension scheme

  • Private medical, dental and vision insurance (medical history disregarded)

  • Group life insurance at 4x annual income

  • Comprehensive mental health support, including unlimited access to 1:1 sessions with trained professionals

  • Unlimited holiday allowance (+ bank holidays) and one week of remote working per quarter

  • Lunch voucher (£10) every day for JustEat and free dinner on those days where you need to work later

  • Twice weekly deliveries of fresh fruit and an extensive selection of snacks and drinks

  • YuLife subscription, allowing you to turn your daily steps and meditation into discounts at a range of stores

Disclaimer - We use Granola, an AI notetaker, throughout our interview process to help capture notes. It's used only for note-taking during the conversation. Transcripts aren't saved to shared drives or stored externally. Let us know if you'd prefer we don't.

Enterprise Product Manager - ElevenCreative
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring an Enterprise PM to own the product experience for businesses using ElevenCreative. ElevenCreative helps creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. A growing share of that usage comes from enterprise teams, including brands, agencies, studios, and media companies that roll it out across their organizations.

You'll own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That covers the admin, permissioning, and governance features large organizations need to deploy ElevenCreative across teams, as well as the enterprise products we're building on top of the platform, like our Ads Engine. You'll work directly with sales and customers to understand what's blocking deals and adoption, scope and define the big bets, and ship them.

PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward go-to-market or customer work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for enterprise teams.

What you'll do

  • Own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, packaging, go-to-market, and customer levers to drive results

  • Scope and define the big bets for enterprise, from discovery through launch and adoption

  • Build the admin and governance layer enterprises need, including role-based permissions, visibility into who has access to what, usage and spend controls, and reporting across teams

  • Partner with engineering to scope and ship enterprise products like Ads Engine, turning complex customer workflows into products that scale beyond a single account

  • Work with sales to triage feature requests and deal blockers, prioritize across them, and close the gap between what customers need and what we ship

  • Join customer conversations to understand how enterprise teams evaluate, buy, and roll out creative tooling, and bring those insights back into the roadmap

  • Define success metrics for enterprise features and track adoption, expansion, and retention across accounts

  • Work closely with engineering, design, sales, and growth to ship quickly and drive projects all the way through

Requirements

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with recent experience owning enterprise or B2B product

  • A track record of owning revenue, growth, or adoption outcomes and driving them across multiple levers

  • Experience shipping enterprise capabilities such as admin, permissions, billing, or security, and driving adoption across large customer accounts

  • Deep familiarity with how creative, marketing, and media teams work, and a habit of bringing customer insights into every product decision

  • Experience scoping and defining large, ambiguous bets and owning them end to end

  • Experience working directly with sales and customers and turning a high volume of requests into a clear, prioritized roadmap

  • Design-minded, with a high bar for product quality and the ability to mock up concepts and workflows yourself

  • Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on architecture, integrations, and tradeoffs

  • Strong product judgment and a clear point of view on what to build and why

  • A bias toward shipping and iterating over long alignment cycles

  • Curiosity about AI and creative tools, and close attention to how the space is moving

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a Swiss data and AI consulting company helping organisations in traditional industries solve complex challenges in areas such as operations, finance, manufacturing and R&D. We work at the intersection of technology and business, delivering data and AI solutions that create practical value for our clients.

Our teams have delivered projects across industries including automotive, chemicals, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We are a Palantir partner and work with clients across the full data and AI journey, from understanding a business problem to building and deploying the solution.

Unit8 has delivered more than 300 projects and grown to a team of 190+ talented people across ten office locations. Following our growth across Europe and our expansion into North America, we are now building our presence in the United Arab Emirates. We are looking for a Palantir Foundry Engineer to join us in Abu Dhabi. This role is based in the UAE and includes relocation from Switzerland with full immigration and relocation support.

Requirements

About the Role

As one of the first members of Unit8’s team in the UAE, you will help deliver Foundry solutions for clients while contributing to the growth of our presence in the region.

You will work directly with client teams to understand their data and operational challenges, then design and build solutions that address them. The role combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration across business and technical teams. You will also contribute your technical perspective during early client discussions and help shape practical approaches to new opportunities.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, deploy and maintain data solutions using Palantir Foundry.
  • Develop and troubleshoot data pipelines and processing systems using Foundry and relevant open-source or proprietary technologies.
  • Build and maintain Foundry components such as Ontologies, pipelines, and user-facing applications.
  • Apply sound engineering practices for testing, data quality, performance, security and maintainability.
  • Work with client stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify problems and translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product owners and client teams in an agile environment.
  • Contribute to technical discovery and solution scoping for prospective and ongoing engagements.
  • Help establish Unit8’s engineering and delivery approach in the UAE, sharing knowledge with colleagues and supporting the growth of the local team.

About You

We are looking for an experienced Palantir Foundry Engineer with a passion for data and solving complex client challenges. You should be a skilled professional who has:

* Foundry Platform Knowledge

    • Demonstrated experience with AIP, Workshop, Code repository, and Pipeline Builder.
    • A solid understanding of security concepts within Foundry, including restricted views and markings.
    • Knowledge of Ontology and Data connection.
    • We're interested in the technical details of what you've built and how you approached the architecture of your Foundry use-cases.

* Programming Skills - proficiency in Python and PySpark.

* Data Skills (Nice-to-have) - knowledge of data modeling and basic concepts of data science (classification, clustering, regression).

* Professional Experience

  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working with the Foundry platform, ideally within a larger company where you may have had a focused but deep exposure.
  • Strong client-facing skills: You are comfortable interacting with both business and technical clients, giving presentations, and possess a strong problem-solving mindset.

* Other

  • You are willing to travel to meet with our clients and the team

Benefits

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to help establish Unit8’s presence in a new market.
  • Hands-on work on client challenges with tangible business impact.
  • Exposure to different industries, projects and technologies.
  • A collaborative team environment with colleagues across Switzerland, Europe and North America.
  • Mentorship and opportunities to develop your technical and consulting skills.
  • Full immigration support for your move to the UAE.
  • Relocation support, including accommodation and travel allowances.
  • Opportunities to contribute to knowledge sharing and projects with a positive impact.

At Optics11, we build advanced sensing technology that helps protect what matters most, from critical offshore energy infrastructure to underwater security systems. Our solutions operate in complex, high-stakes environments where precision, reliability, and real-world performance are essential.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of New Product Introduction (NPI) and Field Integration, ensuring that what is developed by engineering teams can successfully operate in real-world, often offshore environments.   • Coordinate across engineering, operations, supply chain, and external partners to ensure smooth execution

  • Translate ambiguous goals and requirements into clear, actionable plans

  • Drive momentum and remove blockers in fast-moving, real-world environments

Du hast Freude daran, komplexe Themen zu strukturieren, unterschiedliche Beteiligte zusammenzubringen und Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung zu begleiten? In dieser Position ergänzt du unseren Bereich Supply Chain und übernimmst die eigenständige Koordination und Umsetzung definierter Projekte entlang unserer Lieferkette.
Du sorgst dafür, dass Projektziele, Aufgaben, Verantwortlichkeiten und Timings klar definiert sind, behältst Abhängigkeiten und offene Punkte im Blick und stellst sicher, dass vereinbarte Maßnahmen konsequent verfolgt und umgesetzt werden.
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Supply Chain-Team sowie internen Schnittstellen wie Accounting, Controlling, Sales, IT und E-Commerce zusammen und koordinierst projektbezogen auch die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Dienstleistern sowie unseren Kollegen aus Europa und China.
Ziel der Rolle ist es, zusätzliche Projektkapazität innerhalb unserer Supply Chain zu schaffen, bereichsübergreifende Themen strukturiert voranzutreiben und deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung sicherzustellen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Selbstständige Strukturierung übernommener Themen: Du verschaffst dir einen Überblick über die Ausgangssituation, identifizierst Handlungsbedarfe und leitest daraus eigenständig die erforderlichen Arbeitsschritte, Verantwortlichkeiten und Timings ab.

  • Analyse bestehender Prozesse und Abläufe im Rahmen deiner Projekte sowie Erarbeitung und Umsetzung konkreter Optimierungen gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Fachbereichen
  • Transparente Aufbereitung und Kommunikation von Projektständen, Ergebnissen und Entscheidungsbedarfen gegenüber den beteiligten Fachbereichen und Verantwortliche

jobs.title: People Product Lead
jobs.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

Why this role exists

Multiverse builds AI products for the future of work, and we want our own People team to run on the same principles we sell to customers. This role is about building an AI-native People function from the ground up, with someone who thinks in systems: workflows, guardrails, tasks and constraints, rather than one-off fixes. We care more about how you learn and build than how many years you've clocked up. If you've built something you can show us, whether that's a tool, a process, or a system that scaled, bring it. That's a bigger part of the interview than a standard work history.

What you'll actually do

A People Product Lead bridges People strategy with hands-on technical product management. You will build scalable foundations for internal operations such as core HR systems, automation, access, and data flows supporting ~1000 employees across the lifecycle

  • Define the long-term vision, strategy, and quarterly roadmap for internal People Ops technology and platforms including success measures for the domain.

  • Build scalable foundations across People systems that support the employee lifecycle, from core People platforms to integrations, data flows, identity and automation.

  • Make high-quality trade-offs across build, buy and integrate decisions, balancing user experience, scalability, reliability, security and compliance.

  • Lead through influence by aligning senior stakeholders across People, Engineering, Security, Compliance, Legal, Analytics and Operations.

  • Improve productivity and reduce friction for Multiverse employees by simplifying processes and creating intuitive, reliable technology experiences.

  • Drive measurable impact by defining KPIs, learning from delivery and continuously improving how the domain operates.

You will be successful if…

  • You have 5+ years working in HR, in technology, analytics, or operations

  • You think in systems: workflows, guardrails, constraints, and how the parts fit together

  • You have a strong track record of learning fast and applying it

  • You've built something real you can walk us through: a tool, a process, or a system you scaled

This role won’t work for you if…

  • You're uncomfortable working with technology and automation

  • You prefer high-touch, service-led processes over product-led ways of working

Benefits

  • Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

  • Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year

  • Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked!


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS.

jobs.title: Product Owner BakerWare
jobs.description:
De verbindende schakel zijn tussen klanten, business en softwareontwikkeling én bijdragen aan innovatieve softwareoplossingen die gemeenten, belastingsamenwerkingen en waterschappen helpen om hun dienstverlening continu te verbeteren? Het kan als Product Owner bij BakerWare. In deze rol vertaal je complexe vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen die écht werken. Je adviseert klanten, werkt samen met ontwikkelteams en begeleidt de ontwikkeling van gebruiksvriendelijke software die zichtbaar verschil maakt in de dagelijkse praktijk. Maak werk van deze mogelijkheden.

Wat jij doet

Als Product Owner ben jij de verbindende factor tussen onze klanten en het ontwikkelteam. Je begrijpt de uitdagingen van onze klanten, brengt behoeften in kaart en vertaalt deze naar slimme softwareoplossingen. Geen klant en geen vraagstuk is hetzelfde. Bij de ene klant ligt een plan al klaar en bij de andere klant help jij om de behoefte en mogelijkheden te ontdekken. Jij stelt de juiste vragen, denkt mee over processen en zoekt samen met de klant naar de oplossing die écht waarde toevoegt. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces. Samen met het team zorg je ervoor dat klantwensen worden vertaald naar concrete functionaliteiten en kwalitatieve software. Daarbij combineer je adviesvaardigheden, proceskennis en affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling.

Wat doe je nog meer?

  • Je adviseert klanten over procesverbetering en digitale oplossingen.

  • Je analyseert klantbehoeften en vertaalt deze naar concrete oplossingen voor het ontwikkelteam.

  • Je stelt samen met het team user stories op en beheert de backlog.

  • Je draagt bij aan sprintplanningen en begeleidt ontwikkeltrajecten.

  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, toepasbaarheid en gebruiksvriendelijkheid van oplossingen.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met klanten, developers, productteams en andere stakeholders.

  • Je signaleert commerciële kansen en denkt mee over de verdere ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening.

Dit krijg je

Bij BakerWare kun je als Product Owner rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris vanaf €3.510,00 tot €5.040,00 per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

  • Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer van € 0,23 netto per kilometer óf een NS Businesscard

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

Je bent enthousiast, nieuwsgierig en denkt graag in mogelijkheden. Je krijgt energie van complexe vraagstukken, klantcontact en het creëren van slimme oplossingen. Je bent communicatief sterk, overtuigend en weet verschillende belangen met elkaar te verbinden.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau.

  • Ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie als Business Consultant, Product Owner, Functioneel Consultant of een vergelijkbare rol.

  • Kennis van bedrijfsprocessen en ervaring met procesoptimalisatie.

  • Sterke adviesvaardigheden en het vermogen om klantbehoeften helder in kaart te brengen.

  • Een goed analytisch vermogen en een methodische manier van werken.

  • Affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling en digitale dienstverlening.

  • Een commerciële instelling en oog voor nieuwe kansen.

  • Een proactieve houding, eigenaarschap en het vermogen om snel te schakelen.

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift.

Je voelt je thuis in een organisatie waar ruimte is voor eigen initiatief, waar samenwerking centraal staat en waar je samen met klanten en collega’s werkt aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen.

 

Werken bij BakerWare

BakerWare is dé softwarespecialist voor Gemeenten, Belastingsamenwerkingen en Waterschappen! We zijn een gedreven en enthousiaste groep mensen met jarenlange kennis en ervaring die in staat is om de nieuwste ontwikkelingen en vraagstukken om te zetten naar innovatieve en gebruiksvriendelijke software oplossingen. Deze rol vervullen we door ons op te stellen als partner bij de doorlopende ontwikkelingsprocessen van onze klanten.

 

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric

De verbindende schakel zijn tussen klanten, business en softwareontwikkeling én bijdragen aan innovatieve softwareoplossingen die gemeenten, belastingsamenwerkingen en waterschappen helpen om hun dienstverlening continu te verbeteren? Solliciteer naar de functie Product Owner BakerWare. Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met onze Recruiter, Danitsha Abdul via +31 6 10053663 of  

Hier starten jouw kansen  
Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien.

Zodra je Centric komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met de ongeveer 500 collega’s van Digitale Overheid. Als partner van meer dan 300 gemeenten zorgen wij er dagelijks voor dat de dienstverlening van decentrale overheden aan inwoners en bedrijven niet komt stil te vallen. Want wist jij dat bijna alles wat inwoners van Nederland met de overheid regelen via onze oplossingen verloopt? Denk aan lokale belastingen en vergunningen, maar ook aanvraag van reisdocumenten en een uitkeringsaanvraag. Al die gegevens zorgen voor steeds meer inzicht en daarmee voor een nog betere dienstverlening richting inwoners.

We only have positions available for Dutch-speaking applicants residing in the Netherlands.

Centric aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor onze vacatures. Toegestuurde cv’s (in welke vorm dan ook) door genoemde partijen aan enige medewerkers van Centric zonder geldige schriftelijke zoekopdracht van onze HR Afdeling of Recruiters, worden beschouwd als publieke informatie. Er zal aan genoemde partijen geen vergoeding zijn verschuldigd in geval dat een kandidaat wordt aangenomen van wie ongevraagd het cv en/of andere gegevens zijn toegestuurd.

jobs.description:
Als Senior Projectmanager (Program Manager) binnen het People & Process Office van CloudNation ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden van complexe cloud- en AI-programma’s. Je zorgt voor voorspelbare uitvoering, sterke governance en meetbare bedrijfsresultaten. In nauwe samenwerking met de Customer Lead, die verantwoordelijk is voor klantstrategie en waardecreatie, draag jij de verantwoordelijkheid voor delivery, planning, risicomanagement en operationele excellentie over teams, projecten en platforms heen.

Je stimuleert schaalbare dienstverlening, ondersteunt strategische initiatieven zoals het Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE) en benut AI om programmamanagement en uitvoering verder te versterken.

Succes wordt gemeten aan de hand van betrouwbare oplevering, effectief stakeholdermanagement, transparantie, risicobeheersing en continue verbetering binnen cloud- en AI-trajecten.

  • Leid strategische cloud- en AI-programma’s en zorg voor succesvolle levering, sterke governance en aantoonbare bedrijfsresultaten.

  • Vertaal klantdoelstellingen naar uitvoerbare plannen, roadmaps, budgetten en leveringsprioriteiten.

  • Bouw en onderhoud vertrouwde relaties met klant stakeholders, waaronder senior management en directieleden.

  • Stimuleer AI-gedreven delivery door Responsible AI, compliance, kwaliteit en operationele excellentie te integreren in de uitvoering.

  • Werk nauw samen met Customer Leads om strategie, uitvoering en governance op elkaar af te stemmen.

  • Signaleer groeikansen en stimuleer de adoptie van strategische proposities van CloudNation, zoals het Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE).

  • Zorg voor heldere rapportages, effectief risicomanagement en continue verbetering binnen programma’s en teams.

Gekoppeld aan het 6D Delivery Model

Discover
Werk samen met Business Relationship Managers en klanten om doelstellingen, drijfveren en uitdagingen te begrijpen, inclusief de gebieden waar AI aantoonbare toegevoegde waarde kan creëren.

Define
Stel duidelijke programmadoelstellingen, scope, tijdlijnen en succescriteria vast, afgestemd op strategische prioriteiten en, voor AI-initiatieven, op data-volwassenheid en compliance-eisen.

Design
Begeleid teams bij het vormgeven van oplossingen met behulp van frameworks zoals Azure CAF & Enterprise-Scale en het AWS Well-Architected Framework, waarbij Responsible AI waar relevant wordt geïntegreerd.

Develop
Stuur op een hoogwaardige en flexibele uitvoering (Agile of Waterfall), inclusief beoordelingsmomenten en kwaliteitscontroles voor AI/ML-ontwikkeltrajecten.

Deploy
Leid de implementatie en overdracht van opgeleverde resultaten, waaronder CCoE-initiatieven en productiegereedheid (inclusief MLOps voor AI-oplossingen).

Continuous Delivery
Ondersteun klanten bij het operationaliseren van resultaten, draag samen met de Customer Lead verantwoordelijkheid voor governance en behoud het overzicht op continue verbetering en waardecreatie.


  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met het leiden van complexe cloudtrajecten, inclusief het aansturen van meerdere teams, budgetbeheer en stakeholdermanagement op senior niveau.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het leiden van complexe programma’s met meerdere teams, waaronder de implementatie van proposities zoals het Cloud Centre of Excellence (CCoE).

  • Sterke ervaring met delivery management in multicloudomgevingen (Azure en AWS), inclusief Azure CAF / Enterprise-Scale en het AWS Well-Architected Framework.

  • Ervaring met AI- en/of dataprogramma’s, inclusief Responsible AI, compliance (zoals de EU AI Act) en de MLOps-levenscyclus.

  • Werkt aantoonbaar AI-ondersteund, bijvoorbeeld met AI-agents zoals Claude of Claude Code, en stimuleert deze werkwijze binnen teams.

  • Sterk in verwachtingenmanagement en in staat structuur en rust te brengen in complexe, veranderende omgevingen.

  • Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden tot en met C-level, met sterke beheersing van risico’s, afhankelijkheden en budgetten.

  • Kan de administratieve aspecten van programmamanagement zelfstandig beheren, waaronder projectinrichting, planning en facturatie.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Project Manager
Agentic Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:

We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next.

This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product.

We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own product strategy, roadmap and execution across our Agentic Surfaces and Harness, powering DeepJudge’s advanced AI reasoning features, with a strong focus on prioritization, user impact, and business value

  • Evolve our chat interface to make sure the user experience is the best fit for our target use cases

  • Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product areas and new strategic initiatives, balancing short-term go-to-market optimization with long-term discovery and strategic vision

jobs.title: Staff Frontend Engineer / Frontend Architect (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Introduction

Teaser

Two products, two backends, one frontend vision: build the AI-first frontend platform and design system that lets our engineers, product managers and designers ship UI at speed. A senior hands-on role with architect-level influence, no people management, and our CPTO as your executive sponsor.

Role at a glance

  • Level: Staff/Principal-level individual contributor – technical leadership, no direct reports
  • Reporting line: VP Engineering. Executive sponsor: our CPTO
  • Products: FactFinder NG (React on a Java backend) and Infinity (React on a .NET/F# backend)
  • Stack you'll shape: React, TypeScript, Web Components, design tokens, Storybook, AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • Team: Product & Technology organization of around 25 people, led by our CPTO, working in a product trio model with product and design
  • Location: Berlin; Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm possible – hybrid with 2–3 office days per week; occasional travel (<10%) for offsites and design-system workshops
  • Start: as soon as possible

About FactFinder

FactFinder is one of the leading product discovery platforms for European eCommerce. For more than 20 years we've applied AI and machine learning to product search, navigation, personalization and recommendations. Our Product Discovery Experience (PDX) spans two products: FactFinder NG, an exact and highly configurable search, and Infinity, a self-learning, behavioral discovery engine. More than 2,000 customers generate over €160 billion in annual GMV on our platform.

We're around 90 people with a new management team, a clear growth plan and reknown investors behind us. Right now we're rebuilding our product and tech organization around an AI-first way of working and agentic commerce – and this role sits at the center of it.

Why this role exists

Our two products run two React frontends with very different technical roots. We need a vision, an architect, and an owner — someone who will unify them into a single, efficient system, build the shared design system on top, and enable product managers and designers to prototype and ship production-grade UI themselves with AI tooling. Incrementally, without a big-bang rewrite, and while both products keep shipping.


Your mission

What you'll do

  • Define and drive the target frontend architecture across both React products – one consistent, efficient React-based system, migrated step by step
  • Build and own our shared design system: tokens, component library and Web Components for embeddable shop UI, tightly aligned with Product Design
  • Create an AI-first prototyping and contribution framework – design system, AI coding tools, guardrails, automated review and CI – so product managers and designers can prototype and contribute production-grade UI
  • Stay hands-on: write a significant share of the critical code, set standards, and pair with and level up our frontend engineers
  • Work with a clear operating split: after architecture-focused first stints, spend around 80% of your time hands-on coding and 20% on architecture, design-system leadership and enablement
What success looks like
  • After 90 days: frontend audit of both products done, target architecture and migration roadmap agreed, design-system tokens and core components live, and the first prototype built and shipped by a product manager or designer on the new framework
  • After 12 months: both products run on the shared design system, the frontend rework shows measurable efficiency gains, and product and design prototype independently as a routine – frontend is no longer the bottleneck


Your profile

Must-have

  • Expert-level React and TypeScript, proven in complex production SaaS frontends
  • A real AI-first engineering practice: you use AI coding tools and agents daily and have built workflows or frameworks that others use – not just "I use Copilot"
  • Design-system architecture: you've built or led a design system (tokens, component library, Storybook or similar) that was adopted across multiple teams or products
  • Web Components (Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, embedding in third-party environments) plus a frontend architecture track record: you've modernized or migrated a frontend stack at least once, ideally several times
  • 6+ years in frontend or software engineering, including 3+ years at Staff, Lead or Architect level – setting technical direction across teams, not just within your own
  • Hands-on today: you write production code yourself – this is not a concept-only architect position
  • Business-fluent English (C1); no formal degree required, your track record counts
Nice-to-have
  • Technical leadership without line management: you've led a SaaS frontend team through a major technology change
  • Meta-frameworks such as Next.js and/or Astro – and a clear view on when to use which
  • Design-to-code and prototyping tooling: Figma workflows, design-token pipelines, AI UI generation (v0, Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based tooling)
  • eCommerce, search or product discovery frontends (search UIs, embeddable shop widgets)
  • React on non-JavaScript backends (Java/Spring, .NET); Fable/Feliz or Ant Design
  • Good German language skills


Bonus Points

Who thrives here

  • Builders who ship code themselves and lead by example
  • Pragmatic simplifiers: incremental migration over big-bang rewrites, no over-engineering
  • Change agents with strong opinions, weakly held – able to transform an organization without burning it out
  • Enablers who enjoy making product managers and designers productive and treat them as peers
Probably not for you if you'd rather produce architecture concepts than running code, want to go deep on one product and leave the cross-product system to others, or are looking for a people-management role.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

What we offer

  • Real ownership with executive backing: you shape the frontend of two products end to end. You report to our VP Engineering; our CPTO is the executive sponsor of this role – both agree the target architecture and migration roadmap with you, and the CPTO reviews your 90-day goals and holds your final interview. A company-level priority, not a side project
  • AI-first as a leadership priority, with the tooling budget to match: Claude Code, Cursor or whatever makes you fastest
  • Impact without switching to management: a Staff/Principal IC track on our career ladder toward Principal/Distinguished – with the option to move into engineering management later if you want to
  • A product trio culture: engineering, product and design as co-owners, outcomes over outputs
  • Competitive compensation that reflects the Staff level of this role
  • Training and conference budget, 30 days of vacation, modern equipment, mobility offers and a company pension plan
  • Hybrid work with 2–3 office days per week in Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm

How we hire

Remote, with feedback within 48 hours after every step:

1. 30-minute intro call with our Recruiter Mirko
2. 60-minute technical interview with our VP Engineering (your future manager) and an engineering lead: one frontend modernization you led, your design-system story, and how you use AI day to day
3. Case study: a hands-on part (AI tools explicitly welcome – walk us through how you used them) and a 45-minute architecture session
4. Team panel and a 45-minute conversation with our CPTO – optionally on site

FAQ

Is this a people-management role? No. It's a senior individual-contributor role: you lead through architecture, standards and enablement, without direct reports.

Who will I report to? Our VP Engineering. The role is sponsored by our CPTO: the frontend platform is one of the CPTO's top priorities, you agree the target architecture and migration roadmap together, and the CPTO holds your final interview.

Which tech stack will I work with? React and TypeScript on both products. FactFinder NG runs on a Java backend, Infinity on .NET/F# (with Fable/Feliz on the frontend). Backend, F# and our search domain are things you can learn here – React expertise, Web Components, design-system architecture and AI-first practice are what you bring from day one.

Is "AI-first" real here, or a buzzword? It's driven by our CPTO and part of the career ladder for every engineer. Your mandate is to take it from individual productivity to organization-wide practice.

Two legacy frontends on Java and .NET – isn't that painful? That's exactly the mandate: unify them, and how is your call. Incremental, not big-bang.

Can I work fully remote? No – the role is hybrid with 2–3 office days per week at one of our offices.

Why eCommerce search? Because agentic commerce is where AI meets real purchase decisions – on our platform that's 2,000+ shops and €160+ billion in GMV a year.

Apply

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile plus links to work you're proud of (GitHub, a design system, a talk, a blog post) – and tell us in three sentences how you use AI in your daily engineering work. No cover letter needed.

Your contact: Mirko Duus

We're building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. About the role

We're hiring our first Product Designer.

Every engineer at Scope is a product engineer: they talk to users, decide what to build and ship it themselves. You'll work the same way, with design as your edge, and help the engineers around you to build a better product. That covers the whole experience, not just the surface: which problem we solve, how the flow works, what happens when things go wrong, and how it all looks. We work in person five days a week from our office in Farringdon.

What you'll work on

Some examples of surfaces in our product that will need your help:

  • Our mobile app gets used inside tanks and on top of pressure vessels. People wear thick gloves, there's usually no signal, and one hand is often holding on to something. Most of what makes a normal app pleasant doesn't apply there, so a big part of the job is figuring out what does.

  • Then there's the report. How AI and the inspector will work together to produce 40 page reports and review them is something nobody has designed well yet.

  • Inspectors but also decision makers should be able to ask things like "Which tanks were over the corrosion limit last year?". Sometimes the right interface will be a chat but often it isn't.

What you'll do

  • Go on site with inspectors and test your designs there, gloves and all.

  • Own the design of every launch, down to the empty states.

  • Prototype fast, in code when it helps.

  • Decide with Ish and Jakob which problems are worth solving.

Who you are

  • Working closely with the Marketing team to develop new ways to increase awareness of Perk and to both evolve and improve the lead qualification process;

  • Become an expert in Perk and our ever-evolving features.

What will you need to succeed?

  • Excellent communication and video presentation skills;

  • Experience working with the UK and Irish Markets 

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken, as if it were your first language

  • Solid experience working in a Sales position and a demonstrated ability to be a pure hunter - proven track record of developing your pipeline through outbound initiatives;

  • Proven track record of developing successful relationships with C-suite executives;

  • Good understanding of B2B solution selling with a short sales cycle;

  • Being hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound;

  • Able to work as an individual contributor, but bearing in mind you are part of a team;

  • Customer-centric mindset;

  • Legal authorisation to work in the UK.

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

Interview process:

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. 🎯 Your main goal will be to turn n8n’s internal AI and automation capabilities into something every function can confidently use, build with, and learn from.

To make that happen, you’ll create the programs, experiences, and foundations that help teams across n8n build their AI and automation fluency:

DRIVE HANDS-ON ENABLEMENT

  • Run weekly, role-specific workshops, prioritizing less-technical functions such as Legal and Customer Support.

  • Lead hands-on sessions where you build live alongside teams, helping them turn real workflows and challenges into working automations.

  • Run Build Along Office Hours and Bounty Hunts that give teams regular opportunities to learn, experiment, and solve problems together.

  • Help teams identify useful automation opportunities, understand the process they are changing, and decide when to reuse an existing solution, build themselves, or involve the Automation team.

OWN DOGFOODING & EXPERIMENTATION

  • Own our monthly Dogfooding Day end-to-end, from planning and coordination through execution and follow-up.

  • Design and run hackathons and other experimentation initiatives that encourage teams to explore new ways of working with AI and automation.

  • Turn learnings and outputs from these initiatives into reusable assets that help other teams move faster.

SCALE AI FLUENCY & COMMUNITY

  • Own periodic AI fluency survey cycles alongside the People team and help calibrate what fluency means across different functions.

  • Build visibility around internal wins and reusable solutions so teams can learn from what others have already created.

  • Identify and support champions across functions, informally leading the emerging Guild and helping automation knowledge spread across the company.

ENABLE SAFE, REUSABLE AUTOMATION

  • Act as product owner for our internal “safe playground,” partnering with IT, Security, Data, and Solutions Engineering on access, credentials, environments, and requirements.

  • Turn outputs from workshops and office hours into reusable templates and resources that teams can easily discover and adopt.

  • Actively help teams reuse existing solutions rather than reinventing them, making automation more accessible and scalable across n8n.

  • Check whether the things built are still in use four weeks later; provide evidence that teams reuse existing assets and can make routine changes without handing everything back to the Automation team.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🛠️ Practitioner-level n8n fluency: You’ve built real, meaningful automations in n8n and are comfortable building live alongside others.

  • 🎓 Technical enablement experience: You’ve run structured, recurring enablement programs such as workshops, office hours, or build-alongs.

  • 🤝 Non-technical audience expertise: You have a strong track record of helping non-technical teams understand, adopt, and confidently use technical tools.

  • 🏗️ Cross-functional ownership: You’re comfortable partnering with IT, Security, and Data teams to define and own requirements around access, credentials, and environments without needing to implement the infrastructure yourself.

  • 🌍 CET overlap: You’re based in a time zone that gives you strong overlap with Central European working hours, within a couple of hours of Berlin.

  • 💬 English fluency: You have fluent or near-native English and can communicate clearly and confidently with audiences ranging from individual contributors to senior stakeholders.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🐼 Who we are

You. Better. With Alan.

Alan's vision is to make prevention the new norm of care for all. Our mission is to help people live in good health to 100 while helping employers feel proud, turning health benefits from a cost centre into their most valuable investment.

We're building a vertically integrated health partner that seamlessly unites insurance and smart healthcare delivery into one system.

By connecting all aspects of care - private, public, and direct to consumer - we create the most member-centric healthcare experience. Through deep engagement, we empower everyone to overcome day-to-day health obstacles and live healthier lives.

We partner with 35K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M users , and have reached 770M+ in ARR.

Our team of 700+ people (still growing) operates across France 🇫🇷, Spain 🇪🇸, Belgium 🇧🇪, and Canada 🇨🇦.

🤘 How we do it ?

🏆 How we build excellence - We hire the best and empower them to succeed

Our Brand at Alan is precious to us, and is evolving as we grow!

Your missions will include:

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
Web Engineer
Engineering Team Lead, Serverless Containers
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

This is a people-leadership role from day one. You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it.

You will lead the team building our serverless containers product: the way developers run AI apps, MCP servers, APIs, and managed workers on our cloud without thinking about servers. Push a container, get an endpoint, scale from zero to thousands of instances and back down — across CPU and GPU.

On a hyperscaler, the serverless layer is a product someone else built. Here you own it end to end: the scheduler that decides where a container lands, the routing path a request takes, the machinery that turns a scaled-to-zero service into a warm instance before a customer notices. All of it runs on metal, network, and datacenters we own.

That tension is the product: scale-to-zero economics with cold starts in milliseconds, autoscaling that absorbs a launch spike without a config change, GPUs scheduled onto containers the way other platforms schedule CPU. The customers betting on this layer are the developers building the next generation of AI software on European infrastructure.

What You Will Do

  • Own the container platform end to end: image delivery, placement, request routing, scale-up, scale-to-zero — across CPU and GPU.

  • Make cold starts a solved problem: snapshotting, prewarming, image-layer caching, whatever it takes for scale-from-zero to feel instant.

  • Treat AI workloads as the normal case: GPU-backed containers, streaming responses, long-lived connections, MCP servers that cost almost nothing while idle.

  • Write Go alongside your team and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions.

  • Grow the engineers, not just the software — set the standard for ownership and coach people past their comfort zone.

  • Own people management for the team: hiring, performance, growth paths, and honest feedback.

  • Partner with Product Managers to turn platform decisions into a product developers want to deploy on.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • You have built container or workload platforms — orchestration, scheduling, isolation, request routing — not just deployed onto someone else's serverless platform.

  • Deep Linux: namespaces, cgroups, image layers, page cache — comfortable well below the application layer.

  • Multi-tenancy instincts: density, isolation, and fairness when hundreds of customers share one fleet.

  • Significant experience building complex backend or infrastructure systems.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Über GetMentioned

GetMentioned.com ist die SEO-Plattform für Sichtbarkeit in Google und KI-Suchen. Agenturen, Inhouse-SEOs und Marketing-Teams erreichen mit uns Top-Rankings für ihre wichtigsten Suchbegriffe und werden in ChatGPT, Perplexity & Co. genannt. Dafür kombinieren wir unsere eigene Content Engine TextRocket mit einem Online-PR-Marktplatz mit über 100.000 Publishern.

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest das SEO und die KI-Sichtbarkeit von getmentioned.com. Du entscheidest, welche Themen wir besetzen, welche Seiten wir bauen oder verbessern und was als Nächstes passiert. Daneben betreuen wir noch einige wenige SEO-Kunden, denen du bei Fragen und in der strategischen Beratung zur Seite stehst; der Aufwand dafür hält sich in Grenzen.

Dein Impact

Wir verkaufen Sichtbarkeit in Google und KI-Suchen. Jede Seite, die du nach vorn bringst, bringt Besucher und Anfragen. Und wenn ChatGPT nach dem besten Anbieter für Linkaufbau gefragt wird, soll die Antwort GetMentioned lauten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du legst fest, welche Suchbegriffe und Fragen wir besetzen, in Google und in KI-Suchen.

  • Du planst die Themen, schreibst Briefings und eigene Texte und überarbeitest bestehende Seiten, mit unserer Content Engine TextRocket und KI. Wo es sinnvoll ist, steuerst du Freelancer.

  • Du kümmerst dich um Onpage und Technik: interne Verlinkung, Seitenstruktur, Meta-Daten, strukturierte Daten, Indexierung und Ladezeit, gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini und die AI Overviews GetMentioned nennen, wenn es um Backlinks, Brand Mentions und Digital PR geht.

  • Du planst Links, Erwähnungen und Digital PR für die eigene Marke über unseren Marktplatz.

  • Du beobachtest Search Console, Rankings und KI-Erwähnungen und weißt jede Woche, was sich bewegt hat und warum.

  • Du beantwortest Fragen unserer wenigen SEO-Kunden und gibst ihnen strategische Empfehlungen.

  • Du bringst deine SEO-Praxis in die Plattform ein. Du testest neue Funktionen und sagst dem Produktteam, was Kunden wirklich brauchen.

  • Du verantwortest das SEO von GetMentioned.com gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung.

Woran wir deinen Erfolg messen

  • Das eigene SEO hat einen festen Takt: Mindestens 5-10 neue oder überarbeitete Inhalte pro Woche.

  • Getmentioned.com wächst in Google: Die organischen Klicks laut Search Console steigen von Quartal zu Quartal.

  • GetMentioned wird in KI-Suchen genannt: Wir prüfen jeden Monat ein festes Set an Fragen in ChatGPT, Perplexity und den AI Overviews. GetMentioned wird bei immer mehr davon genannt.

  • Aus Besuchern werden Kunden: Die Registrierungen aus der organischen Suche steigen von Quartal zu Quartal.

  • Kunden bekommen schnell eine Antwort: Fachliche Kundenfragen sind innerhalb eines Werktags beantwortet und landen nicht mehr beim Geschäftsführer.

Was du allein entscheidest

  • Welche Themen und Seiten als Nächstes kommen und wer sie schreibt.

  • Was auf getmentioned.com veröffentlicht und überarbeitet wird, innerhalb unserer Markenregeln.

  • Freelancer beauftragst du ohne Rückfrage, innerhalb eines Monatsbudgets, das wir gemeinsam festlegen.

  • Welche SEO-Empfehlung du unseren Kunden gibst.

  • In welcher Reihenfolge du deine Arbeit angehst, solange alle Termine halten.

Unsere Werte

Nach diesen vier Werten stellen wir ein, geben Feedback und entscheiden, wer mehr Verantwortung bekommt.

  • Ergebnisse. Jede Aufgabe hat ein Ergebnis und einen Termin. Deine Zahlen kennst du, bevor jemand fragt. Wann und wo du arbeitest, entscheidest du, solange du erreichbar bist. Bewerbungen mit Track-Records sehen wir gern.

  • Schnell entscheiden. Fragen sind am selben Tag geklärt. Eine gute Entscheidung heute ist uns lieber als eine perfekte nächste Woche.

  • Direktes Feedback. Wir sagen sofort, was gut war und was nicht, in beide Richtungen. Feedback setzt du beim nächsten Versuch um.

  • Verantwortung vom ersten Tag. Wer ein Problem sieht, kümmert sich darum. Was zweimal von Hand passiert, baust du beim dritten Mal als festen Ablauf oder als Prozess mit unserem Dev Team oder KI.

Wen wir suchen

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre SEO in der Praxis, in einer Agentur oder Inhouse.

  • Du hast schon eine Website selbst nach vorn gebracht und kannst die Zahlen dazu zeigen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit der Search Console, mit Sistrix oder Ahrefs und mit einem Content-Tool wie Surfer.

  • Du schreibst gute Texte selbst mit KI und erkennst, wann ein KI-Text noch nicht gut genug ist.

  • Du priorisierst selbst. Aus zwanzig offenen Themen ziehst du das eine, das jetzt zählt.

  • Du denkst selbst. Bei einem Problem, das du noch nie gesehen hast, stellst du die richtigen Fragen, bevor du loslegst.

  • Du willst Feedback. Sagt dir jemand, was nicht funktioniert hat, machst du es beim nächsten Mal besser und diskutierst es nicht weg.

  • Du nutzt KI jeden Tag und hast Erfahrung in Claude Code / Codex und evtl. auch bereits eigene SEO Tools gebaut

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Gutes Englisch und Wort und Schrift.


Erfahrung mit KI-Sichtbarkeit, im Linkaufbau oder mit B2B- und SaaS-Websites ist ein Vorteil.
Track-Record bei eigenen Projekten und Kundenprojekten ist ebenfalls ein Vorteil.

Ehrlich kommuniziert vorab

  • Die 25 Stunden verteilst du auf alle fünf Werktage, zum Beispiel vormittags. So bist du für das Team und unsere Kunden jeden Tag erreichbar.

  • Wer lieber zuarbeitet oder SEO als Checkliste abarbeitet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.

Was wir bieten

  • 25.000 bis 32.000 € brutto im Jahr bei 25 Stunden pro Woche, je nach Erfahrung. Das entspricht 40.000 bis 51.200 € auf Vollzeitbasis.

  • 25 Stunden pro Woche, remote.

  • Eine eigene SEO-Plattform mit Marktplatz, Content Engine und Daten, die du für unsere eigene Marke voll nutzen kannst.

  • Zugang zu Sistrix, Ahrefs und Surfer sowie KI-Tools und eigenen SEO Abläufen, mit denen wir arbeiten.

  • Direkter Draht zum Geschäftsführer mit mehr als 10 Jahren SEO Erfahrung. Enorme Entwicklungs-Möglichkeit, sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich.

  • Dein nächster Schritt: Wächst die Arbeit, kannst du mehr Stunden übernehmen und die Leitung SEO und AI Search mit eigenem Team aufbauen - auch international.

So läuft die Bewerbung

  1. Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf inkl. Website, die du nach vorn gebracht hast, mit den Zahlen dazu. Beantworte in deiner Bewerbung in genau drei Sätzen: Warum willst du genau diese Stelle? Wie genau du diese Anleitung befolgst, ist schon Teil der Auswahl.
