The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

Real-time decision-support data architecture

Replacing point-to-point integration across a multi-vendor estate with a microservices architecture and a common data layer, so that operational data flows in near real time instead of over days. The work includes target-state architecture and decision records, change-data-capture ingest pipelines from upstream data services, ontology and mapping-layer design across suppliers with competing data models, separation of system, reference and insight data classes including time-series, and deployment topologies spanning cloud-hosted services down to constrained edge hardware.

Legacy-to-document-model migration at national scale

Migrating hundreds of millions of records and tens of terabytes of XML out of a legacy relational platform into a sharded document store, in support of a COBOL-to-Java microservices rewrite. The work includes a configuration-driven XML-to-JSON transformation framework backed by a versioned schema registry — twenty years of history, multiple record types and continual schema and semantic drift; CDC and streaming pipelines, or a checkpointed parallel bulk-extract alternative; a field-level mapping validation and reconciliation framework robust enough to stand up to audit; a replay and failure-diagnostics harness with dead-letter routing and idempotent re-runs; and repeated dress rehearsals toward a single cutover window with no dual running.

Monolith decomposition and data-ownership migration

Breaking a distributed monolith of well over a hundred Java services sharing a handful of database clusters into domain-owned services — moving from borrowed data to owned data without reintroducing hidden coupling. The work includes bounded-context analysis to establish which domain genuinely owns which collections, in-place data remodelling ahead of any physical move, a data-access facade with feature-flagged per-request routing between old and new stores, dual-write / backfill / reconcile / read-switch cutover lifecycles with a defined rollback at every step, cluster-to-cluster streaming and live migration tooling, and automated parallel-run and diff-on-read testing.

What you will be doing

Emphasis varies by role and programme, but MongoDB is the common thread. Every one of these engagements involves modelling for it, migrating onto it, or building on top of it, and genuine depth here is what most differentiates candidates.

Architecture and design

•      Produce high- and low-level designs, security and data architectures, and architecture decision records — and take them through client design authorities and formal governance gates

•      Make and defend architectural trade-offs in front of both engineering and non-technical stakeholders, including client technical authorities and third-party suppliers

•      Analyse real access patterns and validate target MongoDB document models against genuine throughput, query and sharding requirements before they are baselined

•      Design integration boundaries in multi-vendor programmes where you own one component and must collaborate across the seams of others

Hands-on build

•      Build production Java services and RESTful APIs (Spring Boot or similar), designed for integration by multiple consuming systems and documented to OpenAPI

•      Design and implement MongoDB document models, aggregation pipelines, indexing and sharding strategies, and integrate them cleanly into Java service layers rather than through a leaky abstraction

•      Build data pipelines: CDC and streaming ingest, transformation frameworks, checkpointed batch extract workers, and MongoDB sink configuration and tuning at terabyte scale

•      Implement access control, encryption and audit within the application and data layer, including enforcement inside the MongoDB query path, rather than bolted on around it

•      Write the tests: unit, integration, golden-record fixtures, parallel-run reconciliation, and load and stress harnesses that prove performance under realistic volumes

•      Work across both MongoDB Atlas and Enterprise Advanced, including Kubernetes-hosted deployments, and with the migration and sync tooling around them

Data modernisation and migration

•      Model relational, XML or other legacy schemas onto MongoDB document models, handling schema and semantic drift through versioned, configuration-driven mappings rather than forked code

•      Design and prove cutover mechanisms — dual-write, backfill, reconcile, read-switch, rollback — for systems where a failed migration is not an acceptable outcome

•      Build validation and reconciliation tooling that satisfies audit: completeness, field-level fidelity, and query-level equivalence between old and new

Security, access control and assurance

•      Design and implement attribute- or role-based access control models, including enforcement at the data layer and policy administration

•      Work with application-layer and field-level encryption — MongoDB client-side field level and queryable encryption, and externally managed key material

•      Produce tamper-evident audit trails and observability that answer not just what happened but why

Client-facing delivery and enablement

•      Work as an embedded member of a small delivery team, frequently alongside client engineers and other suppliers

•      Run workshops, playbacks and sprint demonstrations; produce design documentation, integration guides and operational runbooks

•      Support knowledge transfer and upskilling of client teams — on these programmes enablement is a deliverable, not an afterthought

•      Use AI-assisted engineering tooling as part of normal delivery, within the constraints client security policy sets


Essential

•      Strong hands-on Java — building and running production services and RESTful APIs with Spring Boot or an equivalent framework

•      MongoDB — solid working experience covering document modelling, querying, aggregation pipelines and indexing, and integrating MongoDB into Java application layers. Atlas and/or Enterprise Advanced

•      Data-intensive systems — demonstrable experience of pipelines, migrations or integrations at meaningful scale, and sound reasoning about throughput, ordering, idempotency and failure recovery

•      API design — clean, well-documented REST interfaces suitable for integration by multiple consuming systems

•      Testing — genuine automated testing discipline, plus practical experience of load and stress testing against realistic volumes

•      Infrastructure and deployment — Terraform or equivalent infrastructure as code, containerised deployment on Kubernetes, and AWS or a comparable cloud

•      Communication — able to write clear design documentation and hold your own in a client design authority or architecture review

•      UK resident, and either holding current UK SC clearance or clearly eligible to obtain it

For architect-level roles we additionally expect:

•      Proven design authority on a delivery of comparable size and sensitivity, while remaining hands-on enough to prototype, pair and review code

•      Experience operating inside multi-vendor or multi-supplier programmes, including holding a technical position when other suppliers hold a different one

Desirable

•      UK public sector, or another regulated and security-conscious environment

•      Kafka and change-data-capture tooling such as Debezium; stream processing

•      Legacy modernisation patterns — strangler fig, operational data layers, dual running and phased cutover

•      Domain-driven design and bounded-context analysis; monolith decomposition

•      Attribute-based access control and policy-as-code frameworks (OPA, Casbin, XACML-based systems)

•      Field-level or client-side encryption, key management, HSM/KMS and KMIP integration

•      Search — Lucene-based or Atlas Search, vector search, hybrid retrieval and RAG patterns

•      Metadata standards such as DCAT or Dublin Core; data cataloguing, data mesh and federated data architecture concepts

•      Event-driven architecture and consistency patterns in distributed systems (saga, eventual consistency)

•      Oracle, COBOL or other mainframe and legacy platform familiarity

•      Time-series or geospatial data; deployment to constrained or edge hardware

•      AI-assisted development workflows and agentic coding tools

Working context

Engagement  Contract. Typically three to twelve months per programme, with a strong likelihood of rolling onto the next. Some roles begin part-time through a design phase before going full-time for build.

Clearance  SC clearance is the standard requirement for these roles, and current SC will always be the fastest route onto a programme. We will consider especially strong candidates who hold BPSS only and can sponsor SC in those cases, though clearance takes roughly three months and start dates will reflect that.

Residency  UK resident. All work on these programmes is delivered from the UK by UK-onshore staff.

Working model  Predominantly remote with periodic onsite attendance. Locations vary by programme — expect occasional travel to client sites including London, Manchester and Leeds.

Environment  Work is typically delivered through client-supplied devices or VDI, with VPN access to client environments. You should be comfortable operating within defined information-handling and access constraints, and with the pace that government security and onboarding processes set.

Team shape  Small, focused, multi-disciplinary teams. On several programmes gravity9 delivers alongside partner organisations and other suppliers, and you will need to work effectively across those boundaries.

Timing  These roles support a growing pipeline of central government work. Some engagements are contracted and mobilising; others are in contract negotiation with expected start dates in the coming months. We are building the bench now so that we can mobilise quickly, and clearance lead times mean early conversations are worthwhile even where a start date is not yet fixed.

jobs.title: Senior Projectmanager
jobs.description:
Werken bij een verzekeraar saai? Niet bij Univé! 

Wie ben jij

Jij bent een verbindende projectleider met sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en gevoel voor bestuurlijke verhoudingen. Je behoudt overzicht in een dynamische omgeving, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor resultaatgebieden en weet mensen mee te nemen in verandering. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen operationeel, tactisch en strategisch niveau en creëert draagvlak bij verschillende stakeholders.

Verder beschik je over:

  • hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau;

  • minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als IT-projectleider, programmamanager of delivery lead;

  • ervaring binnen complexe enterprise IT-omgevingen;

  • kennis van Agile/Scrum en hybride projectmethodieken;

  • ervaring met stakeholdermanagement op managementniveau;

  • aantoonbare kennis van en ervaring met het begeleiden van RFI- en RFP-trajecten, inclusief requirementsvorming, marktverkenning, leveranciersselectie, beoordelingsprocessen en contractvoorbereiding;

  • affiniteit met IT-governance, servicemanagement en security/compliance;

  • sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, organisatiesensitiviteit en besluitvaardigheid.

Pré

  • ervaring binnen financiële dienstverlening of de verzekeringssector;

  • kennis van DORA, ITSM, cloudtransities, sourcingvraagstukken en aanbestedingstrajecten via RFI/RFP;

  • ervaring met OKR's en waardestroomgericht werken;

Voor deze rol zijn vooral de volgende competenties belangrijk:

Verbindend leiderschap, resultaatgerichtheid, organisatiesensitiviteit, analytisch vermogen en besluitvaardigheid. Je brengt structuur aan in complexe omgevingen, communiceert helder, creëert draagvlak en weet samenwerking tussen verschillende stakeholders effectief te organiseren.

Wat ga je doen

Als Projectleider binnen IT Kern bij Univé ben je verantwoordelijk voor het initiëren, coördineren en realiseren van organisatiebrede IT-projecten en verandertrajecten. Je opereert in een complexe omgeving waarin continuïteit, security, compliance, servicemanagement en digitale transformatie samenkomen.

Je werkt nauw samen met teammanagers, product owners, servicemanagers, architectuur, securityspecialisten, leveranciers en stakeholders binnen de Regionale Univé's.

Je zorgt ervoor dat projecten voorspelbaar, beheerst en met draagvlak worden uitgevoerd. Daarbij bewaak je de balans tussen run, change, innovatie en compliance.
Binnen IT Kern werk je aan trajecten die direct bijdragen aan de strategische beweging van Univé richting een moderne, omnichannel en toekomstbestendige IT-organisatie.

Wat ga je doen?
Als Projectleider IT Kern leid je complexe IT-projecten en verandertrajecten binnen een organisatiebrede context. Je zorgt voor een heldere projectaanpak, bewaakt voortgang, risico’s, afhankelijkheden, budget en kwaliteit, en stuurt multidisciplinaire teams aan. Je verbindt operationele IT-vraagstukken met strategische doelen en zorgt voor draagvlak bij management, CIO Office, Regionale Univé’s, leveranciers en interne IT-teams. Daarnaast begeleid je waar nodig RFI- en RFP-trajecten, van scopebepaling tot leveranciersselectie en overdracht naar implementatie.

Resultaatgebieden
De belangrijkste resultaatgebieden zijn:
Project- en teamsturing
Je stelt projectplannen op, organiseert projectteams en stuurt interne en externe betrokkenen aan op het behalen van het gewenste resultaat.
Governance en besluitvorming
Je zorgt voor duidelijke documentatie, rapportages en besluitvorming, onder andere richting stuurgroep en management.
Stakeholdermanagement
Je informeert, betrekt en verbindt stakeholders binnen IT, business, Regionale Univé’s en externe leveranciers.
Voortgang, kwaliteit en verbetering
Je bewaakt planning, capaciteit, risico’s en resultaten, evalueert projecten en draagt bij aan verbetering van projectmanagementaanpak en werkwijzen.

Algemene onderwerpen binnen de functie
Binnen de functie werk je aan thema’s die bijdragen aan een toekomstbestendige IT-organisatie, zoals IT-continuïteit, DORA en IT Assurance, security en autorisatiemanagement, cloudtransitie en sourcing. Ook spelen servicemanagement, governanceontwikkeling, waardestromen, roadmaps, OKR’s, kwartaalplanning en capaciteitsmanagement een belangrijke rol. Daarbij bewaak je steeds de balans tussen run, change, innovatie en compliance.

Wat bieden wij

Bij Univé IT bieden we je een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische organisatie. Je krijgt een rol waarin je zichtbaar bijdraagt aan de digitale transformatie van Univé en waarin je samenwerkt met gedreven professionals binnen IT Kern.

Deze functie is ingedeeld in schaal 10. De salarisrange ligt tussen € 64.830,24 en € 93.155,08 bruto per jaar op basis van een 38-urige werkweek. Dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning.


De belangrijkste arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rijtje:

  • een prima salaris, afhankelijk van je opleiding, ervaring en competenties;

  • 13e maand;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • variabele Collectieve Prestatie Beloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;

  • arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd;

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;

  • goede studiekostenregeling;

  • prima pensioenvoorziening;

  • reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding;

  • korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Het team heeft een fijne werkplek in Zwolle, vlakbij het station. In overleg met het team behoort 2 tot 3 dagen thuiswerken tot de mogelijkheden.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dicht bij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. We richten ons op het voorkomen van risico's, het beperken van gevolgen en het verzekeren wanneer dat nodig is. Vanuit onze coöperatieve kracht ontwikkelen we samen continu nieuwe producten, diensten en oplossingen voor onze leden.

 

Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren naar een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platformorganisatie. Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé.

 

Drie focusgebieden

De IT-organisatie is ingericht met drie primaire afdelingen op de focusgebieden Kern, Data en Distributie. De CIO Office biedt ondersteuning door richting en houvast te geven aan strategische doelen en kaders.

 

IT Kern

De afdeling IT Kern bestaat uit vier teams:

• Services - werkplekdiensten, 1e lijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.

• Frontend Platform - applicatiemanagement van platformen die vooral het contact met onze leden ondersteunen, zoals de online omgeving, CRM en telefonie.

• Backend Platform - applicatiemanagement van platformen die de achterkantprocessen ondersteunen, zoals polis-, claim- en financiële administratie.

• Infra & Security Platform - cloud center of expertise en operationele securityactiviteiten.

Overige informatie

Enthousiast?

Vragen?
Wil je eerst meer informatie over de functie of de procedure, dan kun je mailen naar .

Bijzonderheden
Een screening maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure. Een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure.

Omdat we zoeken naar mensen die perfect bij ons passen houden we de werving en selectie graag in eigen hand. Wij maken daarom geen gebruik van diensten van uitzendbureaus en/of werving & selectiebureaus. 

Let op: je krijgt altijd automatisch een ontvangstbevestiging via de mail. Krijg je deze bevestiging niet binnen 24 uur, neem dan even contact met ons op.

jobs.title: Solution Consultant - R&D
jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

 Benchling Solution Consultants (SC) are the primary solution leads with Benchling’s largest customers and prospects. Their solutions are deployed into complex enterprise IT environments, interfacing with other vendor solutions, lab instruments, and legacy applications. This is a highly visible role that partners with both external and internal teams to develop the optimal solutions that drive the most value for our customers. The SC is a pre-sales role, and as such works closely with Benchling sales leadership, account executives, professional services, and product leaders to ensure the best solutions are presented. SCs work with senior scientific and IT leaders from prospects and customers, to establish credibility and confidence from the first meeting, and to create solutions based on cutting-edge technologies.

The SC must be comfortable with Life Sciences R&D processes and scientific concepts, have experience with enterprise SaaS solutions, and be adept at working with internal and external leaders and stakeholders. You must work as a trusted adviser to translate customer objectives into detailed solutions and effectively communicate and demonstrate those solutions to prospects and customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Effectively partner with account executives, SC peers, and leadership to create account and deal strategies that lead to selection, planning out customer engagements that lead to compelling solutions.

  • Manage organized discoveries to uncover customer needs and requirements that relate to decision criteria and key business issues.

  • Craft solutions based on Benchling capabilities, industry best practices and standard R&D functions, with data models and processes that map to the customer or prospects' science and that fit into their current technology landscape.

  • Present and demonstrate the solution in a persuasive way based on key messages, decision criteria, and key business issues. Manage customer questions and objections and resolve concerns. Ensure that the solution is presented competitively, with awareness of alternatives including build in house.

  • Engage with product management to provide insight into prospect and customer needs and industry trends. Influence the roadmap for market success. Ensure that the roadmap is clear to customers as required to influence buying decisions.

  • Provide leadership by creating reusable solutions, content, and trainings for key areas. Work with the extended team to ensure that they are successful and learn from your expertise. Mentor and partner with other SCs to build their success.

     

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s in Biology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry or similar Life Science field, with a minimum of 4 years of work experience, ideally customer facing.

  • Experience with scientific/informatics software such as LIMS, ELN, or others preferred. Familiarity with antibody engineering software is a plus.

  • Experience in demonstrating scientific software in a pre-sales setting to top 20 biotech and pharma companies is highly desired.

  • Demonstrated capacity to effectively model scientific data, and craft solutions, based on product knowledge and industry best practices. Prior experience in demonstrating and supporting research instruments, reagents or software desired.

  • Understand research technology generally adopted by biopharma companies.

  • Have an agile and adaptable mentality, and can quickly implement new customer engagement processes.

  • Ability to establish as a trusted advisor for scientists, and successfully pitch to scientific buyers.

  • Must be fluent in English. Fluency in German or French is a plus.

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites 25-30%.

  • Master’s in Biology, Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biotechnology, Bioengineering, Biochemistry, Chemistry or similar Life Science field, with a minimum of 4 years of work experience, ideally customer facing.

HOW WE WORK
Flexible Hybrid Work: We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week.

Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring a Public Sector Enterprise Account Executive II to join our Sales team.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

As an Enterprise Account Executive II, you'll own the full sales cycle for a defined set of Public Sector enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, partnering with sales engineering, customer success, and your manager to navigate complex deals. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

This role gives you a book of enterprise accounts to grow and a real say in how you build your territory. You'll work complex deals with multiple stakeholders, and you'll have the support of sales engineering and customer success behind you as you build credibility and close. Camunda’s capabilities are well-aligned to the use cases that will help the DACH Administration digitize and automate for more efficiency and agility - this is an opportunity to shape and build a large and meaningful business!

What You Will Do

  • Build a territory plan that identifies Land opportunities and Expand possibilities, leveraging your extended resources such as Partners, Marketing, Inside Sales, Customer Success.

  • Build account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and economic buyers.

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure a smooth handoff and adoption after close.

  • Represent Camunda's value to business and technical buyers, tailoring the message to what each audience actually cares about.

  • Handle tender processes with precision, observe pipeline health with discipline, manage Forecast with accuracy.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Efficient balance between driving towards a customer vision and achieving short-term projects towards this horizon.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with own initiative. The playbook will not provide all answers in advance!

  • Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked complex deals involving IT, business, and procurement stakeholders, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

  • Developing territory and account planning instincts, orchestrating resources efficiently. You can build a plan with some independence, not just work from a list handed to you, and you're learning to prioritize where your time actually pays off.

  • Experience navigating complex public procurement procedures - knowing and following the processes but also influencing them with initiative and creativity.

  • Comfort selling technical products. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage here, particularly in a Public Sector context, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

  • Negotiation experience under real pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

  • A relationship-building style that goes beyond the transaction. You've had customers start to treat you as an advisor, not just a vendor.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. This frees our engineers to focus on technical depth and our team leads on strategic leadership.

As one of the first hires in this group, you will manage a programme and help build the PM structure itself alongside team leads and fellow TPMs. You own execution – schedule, cross-disciplinary coordination, risk, and delivery. The engineers run the technical depth; you run the programme.

What You’ll Do

· Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery

· Build and maintain programme plans spanning propulsion, structures, avionics, systems engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and regulatory dependencies; identify and resolve critical path risks early

· Run programme reviews and cross-functional coordination meetings; keep decisions documented and actions closed

· Work closely with engineering leads across disciplines to track technical progress and translate it into clear programme status

· Coordinate system integration activities – ensuring interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, structures, avionics, GSE) are managed, dependencies tracked, and integration milestones owned

· Manage external dependencies: supplier lead times, test facility scheduling, regulatory submissions, and customer milestones

· Proactively flag scope creep, resource conflicts, and schedule risk to leadership – with options, not just problems

· Contribute to building the PM structure, tools, and ways of working for the department alongside team leads and fellow TPMs

Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, systems, or a related engineering discipline

· 5–8 years in a hardware-heavy development environment; at least 2 in a project management, programme coordination, or technical lead role – career PMs without hardware exposure will not be considered

· Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware domain; familiarity with vehicle-level or system-level development and qualification cycles is essential

· Experience managing cross-disciplinary programmes spanning multiple engineering domains (structures, propulsion, avionics, or similar) is a strong advantage

· Able to manage multiple concurrent projects across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and testing

· Strong systems thinking – able to see the full picture, spot where the hard problems are likely to sit, and know when to dive into detail without losing the overall programme

· Strong planning skills – able to build a programme schedule from scratch, identify critical path, and keep it current

· Comfortable building structure in an ambiguous environment; pragmatic over bureaucratic

· Clear, direct communicator in English; German is an advantage

jobs.title: Non-Eng Template
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Privacy Program Manager to join our Legal Team and help build and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program. In this role, you will translate privacy requirements into effective, repeatable processes across the company and drive the day-to-day operation of key privacy initiatives.

You will work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, Safety, and GTM teams to operationalize privacy-by-design, manage privacy assessments and compliance workflows, and strengthen the systems and processes that support ElevenLabs’ growing global business. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep privacy program experience with strong project management skills and enjoys building scalable programs in a fast-moving AI environment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and continuously improve ElevenLabs’ global privacy program, translating legal and regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes and controls.

  • Own and coordinate privacy compliance workflows across frameworks including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, HIPAA, and applicable biometric privacy requirements.

  • Manage privacy impact assessment processes, including Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and assessments involving AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, health information, and other sensitive data.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Security teams to operationalize privacy-by-design throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Maintain data inventories, records of processing activities (RoPAs), data flow documentation, and other privacy governance records.

  • Manage processes for data subject and consumer rights requests, including access, deletion, correction, and opt-out requests, and help ensure requests are handled consistently and within applicable deadlines.

  • Partner with Security and Legal on third-party and vendor privacy assessments, data processing requirements, and privacy-related risk remediation.

  • Support privacy incident response and regulatory or customer inquiries by coordinating documentation, stakeholders, timelines, and follow-up actions.

  • Implement and administer privacy tooling and automation to improve the efficiency and scalability of privacy operations including maintaining ElevenLabs’ consent management platform and partnering with Legal, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to ensure cookie, tracking technology, and other consent and preference mechanisms are appropriately configured, documented, monitored, and updated as our products and regulatory requirements evolve.

  • Develop privacy program metrics, dashboards, and reporting to track compliance, identify risks, and communicate program maturity and priorities to stakeholders.

  • Develop and maintain privacy policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, and internal guidance.

  • Coordinate privacy training and awareness initiatives across the company.

Who you are

  • Excited by AI and emerging technologies and interested in solving novel privacy challenges involving voice, biometrics, health information, and other sensitive data.

  • An exceptional program manager who can turn complex requirements into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

  • Comfortable operating across Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, and commercial teams and able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, while able to prioritize effectively and maintain momentum across multiple workstreams.

  • Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with a strong instinct for building processes that manage risk without creating unnecessary friction.

  • Comfortable building programs and processes from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What you bring

  • 6+ years of experience in privacy program management, privacy operations, data governance, compliance, or a related field, ideally within a technology, SaaS, or AI company.

  • Demonstrated experience operationalizing privacy requirements under frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other US state privacy laws as well as sector specific frameworks such as HIPAA and biometric privacy requirements.

  • Technical mindset, you can read a data flow diagram, understand system architectures and keys to data handling and can translate between legal requirements and engineering implementation.

  • Experience building or significantly improving privacy review processes, privacy impact assessments, or privacy control frameworks.

  • Hands-on experience managing consent management platforms and cookie/tracking technology compliance, including consent configuration, preference management, and coordination with technical and marketing teams.

  • Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar.

  • Privacy certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT are a plus.

  • Excellent project management, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role

Hi there! We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive III to join our Sales team.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer, not just closing the deal in front of them. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

This role carries real weight. You'll be responsible for a book of enterprise accounts where the deals are complex, the buying committees are large, and the technical bar is high. There's meaningful room here to shape how your territory gets built, not just execute against someone else's plan.

As an Enterprise Account Executive III, you'll own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, working alongside sales engineering, customer success, and leadership to get complex deals across the line. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large, strategic accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

What You Will Do

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Build and drive strategic account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and executive buyers.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure a smooth handoff after close.

  • Represent Camunda's value to senior leaders and technical buyers, tailoring the pitch to what each audience actually cares about.

  • Forecast accurately and manage pipeline health with discipline, not optimism.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Negotiation experience under genuine pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

jobs.title: iOS Developer
jobs.description:
iOS Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en RTL met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een ervaren iOS Developer. Iemand die energie krijgt van het bouwen aan apps die miljoenen mensen dagelijks gebruiken. Je denkt verder dan code alleen en werkt graag samen aan betekenisvolle producten.

Jouw rol

Als iOS Developer ben je een ervaren software engineer die graag kennis deelt binnen een hecht team. Je zet de gebruikerservaring altijd centraal en bouwt mee aan stabiele, schaalbare mobiele architecturen. De techstack met Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, MVVM-C en TCA is voor jou bekend terrein.

Je werkt nauw samen met product owners, testers en Android engineers aan complete platformen. Samen vertalen jullie complexe klantvragen naar vloeiende mobiele applicaties. Je krijgt de vrijheid om jouw expertise in te zetten en processen continu te verbeteren.

Wat je gaat doen:

  • Je bouwt mee aan bekende applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, RTL Boulevard en het KNMI.

  • Je deelt jouw kennis binnen een mobile team van 35 specialisten.

  • Je vertaalt designs naar vloeiende animaties en intuïtieve interfaces.

  • Je waarborgt de codekwaliteit via code reviews en testautomatisering.

  • Je adviseert klanten over de beste technische keuzes voor hun platform.

  • Je levert een actieve bijdrage aan onze eigen kennisevents, zoals Appdevcon.


Wie ben jij?

Je hebt minstens vijf jaar ervaring met mobile development en ontwikkelt zelfstandig native iOS applicaties. Je bent blijvend leergierig en past je snel aan in een veranderende omgeving. De techstack met Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, MVVM-C en TCA is voor jou bekend terrein.

Samenwerken in een divers team is voor jou vanzelfsprekend. Je toont eigenaarschap en kijkt kritisch naar je eigen werk om de hoogste kwaliteit te garanderen. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, RTL Boulevard en het KNMI.

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6500,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.

  • De 'Gadget Kit': Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot entertainment en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dat maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een diverse groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis en zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen iOS) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

  • Bestaande klantaccounts helpen groeien door proactief mee te denken over hun digitale transformatie.


Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een daadkrachtige spin in het web met een scherpe blik op tastbare meerwaarde voor de klant. Je hebt aantoonbare, meerjarige ervaring als Projectmanager in het succesvol leiden van complexe, omvangrijke maatwerk softwareprojecten (ervaring in de mediasector is een pre). Je combineert een strategische langetermijnvisie moeiteloos met een hands-on executie. Ervaring in de mediasector is een pré.

Je schakelt soepel tussen Agile/Scrum-methodieken en traditionele fixed scope/fixed price - trajecten. Als communicatief sterke professional bewaar je de rust bij tegenslag en weet je hoe je met tact en daadkracht slecht nieuws overbrengt. Je hebt ervaring met stakeholdermanagement op C-level niveau van veeleisende corporate of Enterprise klanten, waarbij je duurzame relaties opbouwt, overtuigend adviseert en effectief onderhandelt over prioriteiten en resources. Je bent empathisch, verbindend en voelt je thuis in een 'remote first' werkomgeving waar vakmanschap de standaard is. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland en spreek je vloeiend Nederlands.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • De 'Gadget Kit': Alle devices die je nodig hebt om mee te kijken op jouw projecten én een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Data Platform (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your Job

As Engineering Manager, Data Platform at Statista, you’ll lead the engineers building a platform-as-a-product that helps teams manage and share trusted data. You’ll make it easier for data producers to get started while ensuring the platform is secure, reliable and cost-conscious as it grows.

You’ll work closely with the Senior Platform Product Manager: they lead product vision and priorities; you lead the people, technical delivery and day-to-day operation of the platform. The role spans Snowflake-based data infrastructure and event streaming via Kafka.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and grow the team. Lead a mixed team of DevOps, software and data engineers with shared ownership, on-call and standards. Grow people through clear expectations, regular feedback and real ownership, and hire as the platform grows.

  • Run the platform as a product. Partner with the Senior Platform Product Manager, make it easy for teams to put their data on the platform: quick setup, fast reviews, clear documentation, and a say in how the platform develops. Work with data producers, Analytics Engineering and other Statista group companies as partners, not just users.

  • Build trust into the platform. Guide the use of access controls, cost safeguards, audits, data contracts and metadata so teams can share data safely with people, APIs and AI-powered applications.

  • Own reliable event streaming. Run Kafka as the backbone that distributes data and content across Statista: reliable, well monitored, and easy for teams to publish to and consume from.

  • Set technical direction. Guide architecture and build-versus-buy decisions, review designs and pull requests, and use AI and automation where they improve the team's work. You'll stay technically engaged without being expected to code every day.

 

Your Skills

  • At least five years of experience leading engineering teams, ideally in data platforms, platform engineering or infrastructure. You know how to develop senior engineers and unite people with different technical backgrounds.

  • A strong foundation in data or platform engineering, with the confidence to contribute to architecture discussions and design reviews. You're familiar with cloud data warehouses, ideally Snowflake, and tools or practices such as dbt and orchestration.

  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform. You're comfortable with Kubernetes, CI/CD and AWS.

  • Experience operating event-streaming systems such as Kafka, Amazon MSK, Confluent or Redpanda, including a schema registry.

  • You understand data governance, including access models, data contracts, catalogues and lineage. You balance useful safeguards with a straightforward experience for the teams using the platform.

  • You use AI tools and agentic workflows in your daily work and help your team do the same. You understand how AI agents consume data and know how to make the platform and its data assets work well for agents accessing them through MCP or A2A.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

It runs a consumer on/off-ramp platform and a fast-growing B2B infrastructure business: APIs and white-label solutions that let exchanges, neobanks, PSPs, wallets and other platforms embed regulated crypto and fiat services. About the role

This is a senior, hands-on legal role with a single, clear mandate: own the company’s UK regulatory build. You will report directly to the CEO and be the most senior legal voice in the business on UK matters.

The UK’s new cryptoasset regime takes effect in October 2027. From that date, regulated cryptoasset activity in the UK requires FCA authorisation. You will own a first-wave authorisation under this new regime end to end, alongside a UK e-money application. For a regulatory lawyer, this is a career-defining piece of work, and the window to start it is narrow.

The role has no direct reports at hire. You will work closely with the company’s EU legal function. This is a deliberately focused UK mandate, not a group legal role.

What you will own

  • FCA cryptoasset authorisation: perimeter analysis of B2C and B2B activities against the new regime, application strategy, drafting, regulatory business plan input, RFI handling and dialogue through to decision.

  • UK EMI application: ownership on the same basis, including sequencing between the two applications.

  • FCA relationship: acting as the senior in-house legal counterpart to the regulator.

  • UK conduct perimeter: the cryptoasset financial promotions regime, Consumer Duty, the UK Travel Rule, and safeguarding and prudential requirements.

  • Post-authorisation readiness: governance, senior manager and certification considerations, reporting and disclosures.

  • External counsel: briefing, directing and quality-controlling UK external counsel, and managing that spend.

  • International expansion: legal lead on additional licence applications in other jurisdictions, and advice where the UK and EU regulatory perimeters meet.

  • Commercial legal: drafting and negotiating English-law B2B agreements. This includes MSAs, API and white-label terms, referral and agent agreements, and banking, payment and card scheme counterparty agreements.

  • UK consumer-facing legal: consumer terms, financial promotions review and UK-specific disclosures.

  • UK employment: UK employment law and contractor arrangements, in partnership with HR.

What we are looking for

  • Qualified solicitor or barrister in England & Wales, typically with 8+ years PQE.

  • Hands-on UK financial services regulatory experience, including at least one FCA authorisation or variation of permission that you personally owned or materially led, from perimeter analysis to decision.

  • Direct, personal interaction with the FCA: correspondence, meetings and representation that you led yourself.

  • Crypto or digital-asset legal experience at licensed or established firms, such as registered or authorised exchanges, regulated on/off-ramps, licensed custodians or infrastructure providers.

  • Cryptoasset, e-money or payments perimeter experience. Engagement with the 2025–26 FCA cryptoasset consultations is highly relevant.

  • Ability to draft and negotiate English-law B2B fintech agreements independently.

  • A track record of owning regulatory outcomes, not only advising on them. Law-firm backgrounds are welcome where this is evident.

  • Ability to take a clear position under pressure from senior stakeholders and counterparties, and to translate legal risk into business options with a recommendation.

  • Comfort operating as a remote senior with no legal support structure beneath you, working with a leadership team based outside the UK.

  • Practical use of AI tools in legal drafting, research or review.

Team management experience is not required. We welcome strong senior counsel ready to step into a Head of Legal role.

Nice to have

  • Previous Head of Legal, GC or senior counsel role at a UK-authorised EMI, PI or FCA-registered cryptoasset firm.

  • Experience of a firm moving from AML registration to full FSMA authorisation.

  • Involvement in industry working groups or trade association engagement on the new UK crypto regime.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren software engineer of architect die inhoudelijk sterk wil blijven, maar ook graag een team verder brengt?

Bij adesso Nederland zoeken we een Lead Software Engineering. Iemand die technologie, mensen en delivery bij elkaar brengt. Je bent niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van je team, maar blijft zelf dicht bij de inhoud en onze klanten.

Je werkt met ervaren software engineers aan uitdagende klantomgevingen en helpt tegelijkertijd onze Software Engineering-practice verder uit te bouwen. Van Java en moderne frontendtechnologie tot cloud, architectuur en agentic software engineering.

Geen rol waarin je alleen maar gaat managen dus. Je blijft onderdeel van het vak.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Lead Software Engineering geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 5 tot 12 consultants en developers. Je coacht collega's, helpt ze groeien en zorgt ervoor dat zij op projecten zitten die passen bij hun kennis, ervaring en ontwikkeling.

Tegelijkertijd ben je betrokken bij onze klanten en projecten. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van delivery, denkt mee over architectuur en engineeringvraagstukken en springt bij wanneer een project inhoudelijk of organisatorisch extra aandacht nodig heeft.

Je rol bestaat grofweg uit vier onderdelen:

People & team
Je voert 1-op-1's, begeleidt ontwikkeling en performance en helpt collega's bij hun volgende stap. Je zorgt voor een goede onboarding van nieuwe collega's en bent actief betrokken bij recruitment en selectie.

Software Engineering & delivery
Je blijft inhoudelijk betrokken bij software engineering en kunt zelf een leidende rol pakken op een technisch of architectuurvraagstuk. Je bewaakt kwaliteit, planning en risico's en zorgt dat onze teams voorspelbaar en professioneel leveren.

Tegelijkertijd help je engineers zich ontwikkelen richting Agentic Engineering: minder tijd besteden aan het produceren van code en meer aan het definiëren van context, architectuur en kwaliteit, het orkestreren van agents en het reviewen en valideren van de output.

Klanten & commercie
Je ziet wat er bij klanten speelt en vertaalt dat naar kansen voor adesso. Je denkt mee in presales, voorstellen en bids en helpt oplossingen vorm te geven die technisch én commercieel kloppen. Bij bestaande klanten herken je mogelijkheden voor vervolgprojecten en uitbreiding.

Daarbij verschuift de focus steeds meer van het leveren van capaciteit naar het realiseren van engineering outcomes: sneller bouwen, moderniseren en klanten helpen hun engineeringorganisatie toekomstbestendig te maken.

Groei van onze Software Engineering-practice
Je helpt bepalen welke kennis, technologie en capabilities we als team nodig hebben. Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen onder andere Java, frontend, cloud, architectuur en Agentic Engineering en vertaalt die naar onze manier van werken.

Je helpt daarmee niet alleen individuele engineers groeien, maar bouwt mee aan een schaalbare engineering capability binnen adesso.


We zoeken geen klassieke people manager die de techniek inmiddels heeft losgelaten. We zoeken juist iemand die software engineering begrijpt én mensen kan meenemen in de ontwikkeling van het vak.

Je hebt ruime ervaring binnen software engineering en hebt bijvoorbeeld gewerkt als Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead, Lead Developer of Software Architect. Je hebt ervaring met Java en/of moderne software-architecturen en begrijpt wat nodig is om complexe softwareprojecten succesvol te leveren.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je circa 7–8 jaar of meer relevante ervaring binnen softwareontwikkeling en complexe projecten;

  • heb je ervaring met het begeleiden, coachen of aansturen van andere engineers;

  • kun je met zowel developers als klanten en management schakelen;

  • begrijp je onderwerpen als delivery, capaciteit, kwaliteit en projectmarge;

  • heb je ervaring binnen consultancy of projectmatige dienstverlening, of voel je je thuis in zo'n omgeving;

  • vind je het interessant om mee te bouwen aan proposities, presales en klantrelaties;

  • volg je ontwikkelingen rondom AI, AI-agents en Agentic Engineering;

  • beheers je de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed.

Certificeringen op het gebied van Java, cloud, architectuur of software engineering zijn mooi meegenomen, maar voor ons zijn je ervaring en wat je daadwerkelijk hebt gebouwd en geleid belangrijker.

Waarom deze rol interessant is

Dit is een rol voor iemand die op een punt is gekomen waarop alleen zelf software bouwen niet meer genoeg is, maar die óók niet de hele dag in managementmeetings wil zitten.

Je krijgt de ruimte om een team te ontwikkelen, invloed te hebben op onze technische richting, met klanten aan tafel te zitten én zelf inhoudelijk relevant te blijven.

adesso Nederland is met ongeveer 100 collega's compact genoeg om echt invloed te hebben, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een internationale organisatie met meer dan 13.000 collega's. Daardoor combineren we korte lijnen en ondernemerschap met de kennis, klanten en mogelijkheden van een grote Europese IT-organisatie.

En Software Engineering verandert snel. AI-agents gaan steeds meer onderdelen van de software lifecycle ondersteunen, van requirements en architectuur tot development, testing en delivery. Daardoor verschuift het werk van engineers naar het definiëren van context, architectuur en kwaliteit, en het orkestreren, beoordelen en bijsturen van AI. 

Binnen adesso willen we daar niet vanaf de zijlijn naar kijken. Als Lead Software Engineering help je mede bepalen hoe we deze ontwikkeling vertalen naar onze engineers, onze projecten en onze klanten.

Klaar om niet alleen goede software te bouwen, maar ook het team eromheen sterker te maken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (MDM, XDR/EDR/AV) and email / phishing defense.
  • Practical experience securing how a company uses AI internally: shadow AI discovery, DLP for AI tools, controls for AI assistants and agents, and a working risk framework for adopting new ones. You've done this for real, not from a vendor pitch deck.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills — you build tooling against APIs, not just configure consoles.
  • Track record of driving improvements end-to-end and leading initiatives with little oversight. 
  • Сlear written and spoken English for engineers and leadership.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol office, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one. 
Enhance your expertise and shape the future of FinTech. Join Vivid's talented team and help us revolutionize how businesses think about their finances!


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started. 

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

Qui sommes-nous ?

Notre mission

Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation.

⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation. Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement”

👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !

💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux !

Le mot de la CEO

“Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs.
Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon

Et ce poste alors ?

Le rôle

Pour accélérer notre croissance en France et à l’international, nous recherchons notre premier Sales Manager (futur VP Sales). Rattaché(e) directement à Manon (co-founder), qui porte ce rôle aujourd'hui, tu seras un(e) véritable builder, pour transformer un processus de vente encore artisanal en une machine performante, outillée et scalable, au service d'objectifs de croissance ambitieux.

Ce rôle allie une forte implication opérationnelle et une dimension stratégique : tu accompagnes l'équipe au plus près du terrain, tout en structurant notre organisation commerciale et en définissant notre stratégie de croissance.

L’équipe est actuellement composée de deux Account Executives et nous recrutons deux Business Developer.

Missions et responsabilités

1. Stratégie commerciale & Développement

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie Sales en France, puis orchestrer notre expansion sur des marchés européens prioritaires (harmonisation et adaptation du discours).

  • Structurer un processus de vente robuste et industrialisable, adapté à nos cycles de ventes courts (2 à 3 semaines).

  • Construire un reporting fiable et prédictif : suivi des KPIs, forecast, vitesse de closing, cohérence du funnel.

  • Mettre en place et maîtriser la stack de prospection et les automatisations : CRM, séquences, scoring, workflows, alertes, playbooks (HubSpot, Apollo, Zapier, Make, etc.).

2. Management & Leadership

  • Manager et faire monter en compétences l’équipe Sales existante.

  • Installer des rituels qui font progresser l'équipe : points individuels, analyses de calls, coaching, challenges.

  • Entretenir l'énergie et la motivation de l'équipe, avec une culture de la performance exigeante et bienveillante.

  • Anticiper, recruter et piloter les prochaines recrutements pour faire grandir l'équipe.

3. Exemplarité & Exécution

  • Montrer l’exemple et rester au contact du terrain : tu prospectes régulièrement et tu fais avancer ton propre pipe.

  • Mener des démos convaincantes, maîtriser les objections et faire la différence face à la concurrence.

  • Faire remonter les insights terrain aux fondateurs, au Marketing et au Produit.

  • Représenter Solteo auprès des partenaires et acteurs clés du marché.

Les compétences qu’on recherche

  • Expérience : 5 à 7 ans d’expérience globale, dont au moins 2 ans en tant que Lead Sales ou Sales Manager

  • Vente SaaS B2B en cycles courts : une solide expérience de la vente à volume en start-up ou scale-up, quel que soit le secteur.

  • Expérience de structuration et de management : tu as déjà encadré ou fait grandir une équipe commerciale, et tu sais expliquer quels rituels tu as mis en place et quels KPIs tu suis, et pourquoi.

  • ADN "Hands-on" : tu aimes prospecter, faire des démos et closer. Tu veux garder les mains dans le cambouis, avec ton propre pipe.

  • Leadership : tu sais fédérer une équipe, donner une direction claire et créer une dynamique collective.

  • Mindset : autonome, dynamique, proactif(ve) avec une forte fibre entrepreneuriale.

  • Langues : Français et Anglais parfaitement bilingues/fluents.

Ce qui serait un plus

  • Tu viens idéalement de la Construction Tech ou Energy Tech.

  • Connaissance de notre cible : Artisans, acteurs du bâtiment (BTP) ou secteur de l'énergie.

  • Passage par des "écoles de vente" SaaS reconnues pour leur excellence sur des cycles courts (ex: Odoo, Axonaut, etc.).

  • Maîtrise d'une troisième langue : Italien, Espagnol, Allemand ou Portugais.

Mais Solteo c’est aussi…

  • Un cadre professionnel vivant et énergique, où la prise d’initiatives est non seulement appréciée mais également récompensée.

  • La chance de parfaire et d'enrichir tes connaissances dans un secteur en pleine croissance et qui a du sens.

  • Des bureaux situés en plein centre de Paris, avec plusieurs autres start-ups du solaire

  • Une diversité de projets captivants, offrant l'opportunité de collaborer avec des clients diverses et variés. Pas possible de s’ennuyer !

Nous te promettons aussi une ambiance d’équipe bienveillante, accueillante et stimulante. Et bien sûr, plein d’évènements d’équipe !

Processus de recrutement

  • 📞 Entretien avec un recruteur en visio (30 min) : pour discuter de ton CV et des attentes sur le poste avec Mélanie (Talent Acquisition)

  • 🕵️‍♂️ Prise de références

  • 🍽️ Déjeuner d’équipe : rencontre conviviale avec les fondateurs et toute l'équipe Solteo.

  • Rémunération : selon expérience
